# ============================================================
# BIEN QUANG CAO NGOAI TROI - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Dung mo hinh 3D theo anh tham chieu
# Don vi: met
# Cau truc: Group rieng cho tung he thong
# ============================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module BillboardOutdoor3D
  extend self

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO MO HINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  BOARD_W = 18.0
  BOARD_H = 7.0
  BOARD_Z = 11.0
  BOARD_T = 0.12

  COLUMN_X = 0.0
  COLUMN_Y = 0.60
  COLUMN_R = 0.65
  COLUMN_H = 10.90

  FOUNDATION_W = 4.0
  FOUNDATION_D = 3.5
  FOUNDATION_H = 1.0

  TRUSS_W = 18.8
  TRUSS_H = 1.40
  TRUSS_D = 1.20
  TRUSS_STEP = 1.20

  CATWALK_W = 0.70
  CATWALK_Z = BOARD_Z - TRUSS_H - 0.05

  LADDER_X = 1.00
  LADDER_Y = -0.45
  LADDER_Z0 = 0.40
  LADDER_Z1 = 10.80

  LAMP_COUNT = 6

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. DON VI VA VAT LIEU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def mm(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(mm(x), mm(y), mm(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    group = parent.add_group
    group.name = name
    group
  end

  def make_material(name, rgb)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    material = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    material.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    material
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = make_material(
      'BO3D Concrete', [165, 164, 155]
    )
    @concrete_dark = make_material(
      'BO3D Foundation Concrete', [115, 116, 112]
    )
    @steel = make_material(
      'BO3D Galvanized Steel', [155, 165, 173]
    )
    @steel_dark = make_material(
      'BO3D Dark Steel', [65, 73, 80]
    )
    @steel_light = make_material(
      'BO3D Bright Steel', [205, 210, 215]
    )
    @screen = make_material(
      'BO3D Green Advertising Surface', [0, 255, 20]
    )
    @lamp = make_material(
      'BO3D Lamp Housing', [40, 43, 46]
    )
    @lamp_glass = make_material(
      'BO3D Lamp Glass', [255, 242, 200]
    )
    @ground = make_material(
      'BO3D Ground', [185, 183, 176]
    )
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. KHOI HOP
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    corners = [
      pt(x,      y,      z),
      pt(x + dx, y,      z),
      pt(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      pt(x,      y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(mm(dz))

    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 04. THANH THEP HOP THEO HAI DIEM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, p1, p2, size, material)
    direction = p2 - p1
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = vec(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    axis_x = direction.cross(reference)
    axis_x.normalize!

    axis_y = direction.cross(axis_x)
    axis_y.normalize!

    radius = mm(size) / 2.0

    corners = [
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, -radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, -radius)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(length)

    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 05. ONG TRON DUNG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, material, segments = 48)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      mm(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(mm(height))

    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 06. MONG BE TONG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundation(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '01 - Mong be tong')
    entities = group.entities

    # Be tong lot
    add_box(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0 - 0.25,
      COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0 - 0.25,
      -FOUNDATION_H - 0.15,
      FOUNDATION_W + 0.50,
      FOUNDATION_D + 0.50,
      0.15,
      @concrete_dark
    )

    # Mong chinh
    add_box(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0,
      COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0,
      -FOUNDATION_H,
      FOUNDATION_W,
      FOUNDATION_D,
      FOUNDATION_H,
      @concrete
    )

    # Be co cot
    add_box(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X - 1.15,
      COLUMN_Y - 1.05,
      0.0,
      2.30,
      2.10,
      0.35,
      @concrete
    )

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 07. BAN DE VA BULONG NEO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_base_plate(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '02 - Ban de va bulong neo')
    entities = group.entities

    add_box(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X - 0.90,
      COLUMN_Y - 0.85,
      0.32,
      1.80,
      1.70,
      0.12,
      @steel_dark
    )

    [-0.70, 0.70].each do |dx|
      [-0.60, 0.60].each do |dy|
        x = COLUMN_X + dx
        y = COLUMN_Y + dy

        add_cylinder(
          entities, x, y, 0.15,
          0.025, 0.37, @steel_dark, 12
        )

        add_box(
          entities,
          x - 0.055, y - 0.055, 0.43,
          0.11, 0.11, 0.045,
          @steel_light
        )
      end
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 08. COT THEP TRU TRON
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_column(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '03 - Cot thep tru tron')
    entities = group.entities

    add_cylinder(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X, COLUMN_Y, 0,
      COLUMN_R, COLUMN_H, @steel, 64
    )

    # Vong tang cung
    [0.35, 1.0, COLUMN_H - 0.50].each do |z|
      add_cylinder(
        entities,
        COLUMN_X, COLUMN_Y, z,
        COLUMN_R + 0.055, 0.08,
        @steel_dark, 48
      )
    end

    # Ban ma tren dau cot
    add_box(
      entities,
      COLUMN_X - 0.95,
      COLUMN_Y - 0.90,
      COLUMN_H - 0.10,
      1.90, 1.80, 0.18,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Suon tang cung
    12.times do |i|
      angle = 2.0 * Math::PI * i / 12.0

      x1 = COLUMN_X + Math.cos(angle) * COLUMN_R
      y1 = COLUMN_Y + Math.sin(angle) * COLUMN_R

      x2 = COLUMN_X + Math.cos(angle) * 0.98
      y2 = COLUMN_Y + Math.sin(angle) * 0.98

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x1, y1, COLUMN_H - 0.90),
        pt(x2, y2, COLUMN_H + 0.15),
        0.08, @steel_dark
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 09. GIAN KHUNG XUONG THEP KHONG GIAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_truss(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '04 - Gian khung xuong thep khong gian')
    entities = group.entities

    xl = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    xr = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    z_bottom = BOARD_Z - TRUSS_H
    z_top = BOARD_Z

    y_front = -0.20
    y_back = y_front + TRUSS_D

    count = (TRUSS_W / TRUSS_STEP).ceil

    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      # Thanh bien tren va duoi
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xl, y, z_top),
        pt(xr, y, z_top),
        0.09, @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xl, y, z_bottom),
        pt(xr, y, z_bottom),
        0.09, @steel
      )

      # Thanh dung
      (0..count).each do |i|
        x = [xl + i * TRUSS_STEP, xr].min

        add_beam(
          entities,
          pt(x, y, z_bottom),
          pt(x, y, z_top),
          0.055, @steel
        )
      end

      # Thanh cheo
      (0...count).each do |i|
        xa = [xl + i * TRUSS_STEP, xr].min
        xb = [xa + TRUSS_STEP, xr].min
        next if xb - xa < 0.01

        if i.even?
          add_beam(
            entities,
            pt(xa, y, z_bottom),
            pt(xb, y, z_top),
            0.045, @steel_dark
          )
        else
          add_beam(
            entities,
            pt(xa, y, z_top),
            pt(xb, y, z_bottom),
            0.045, @steel_dark
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Thanh ngang noi hai mat gian
    (0..count).each do |i|
      x = [xl + i * TRUSS_STEP, xr].min

      [z_bottom, z_top].each do |z|
        add_beam(
          entities,
          pt(x, y_front, z),
          pt(x, y_back, z),
          0.055, @steel
        )
      end
    end

    # Giang cheo khong gian
    (0...count).each do |i|
      next unless i.even?

      xa = [xl + i * TRUSS_STEP, xr].min
      xb = [xa + TRUSS_STEP, xr].min
      next if xb - xa < 0.01

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xa, y_front, z_bottom),
        pt(xb, y_back, z_top),
        0.04, @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xa, y_back, z_bottom),
        pt(xb, y_front, z_top),
        0.04, @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Ban ma lien ket dau cot
    add_box(
      entities,
      -1.0, y_front - 0.10, z_bottom - 0.12,
      2.0, TRUSS_D + 0.20, 0.12,
      @steel_dark
    )

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. MAT BIEN QUANG CAO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '05 - Mat bien quang cao')
    entities = group.entities

    # Tam hien thi
    add_box(
      entities,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0,
      -0.36,
      BOARD_Z,
      BOARD_W,
      BOARD_T,
      BOARD_H,
      @screen
    )

    frame = 0.10
    frame_y = -0.48

    # Vien tren
    add_box(
      entities,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - frame,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_Z + BOARD_H,
      BOARD_W + 2 * frame,
      0.10,
      frame,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Vien duoi
    add_box(
      entities,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - frame,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_Z - frame,
      BOARD_W + 2 * frame,
      0.10,
      frame,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Vien trai va phai
    add_box(
      entities,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - frame,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_Z,
      frame, 0.10, BOARD_H,
      @steel_dark
    )

    add_box(
      entities,
      BOARD_W / 2.0,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_Z,
      frame, 0.10, BOARD_H,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Thanh gia cuong phia sau
    [-5.5, -2.8, 0.0, 2.8, 5.5].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x, 0.0, BOARD_Z + 0.20),
        pt(x, 0.0, BOARD_Z + BOARD_H - 0.20),
        0.06, @steel
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '06 - San catwalk va lan can')
    entities = group.entities

    xl = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    xr = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    z = CATWALK_Z
    y_front = -0.85
    y_back = y_front + CATWALK_W

    # Mat san thao tac
    add_box(
      entities,
      xl, y_front, z,
      TRUSS_W, CATWALK_W, 0.07,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xl, y, z - 0.05),
        pt(xr, y, z - 0.05),
        0.08, @steel
      )
    end

    # Dam ngang
    count = (TRUSS_W / 1.5).ceil

    (0..count).each do |i|
      x = xl + TRUSS_W * i / count.to_f

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x, y_front, z - 0.05),
        pt(x, y_back, z - 0.05),
        0.05, @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can
    rail_top = z + 1.10
    rail_mid = z + 0.55

    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xl, y, rail_top),
        pt(xr, y, rail_top),
        0.045, @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(xl, y, rail_mid),
        pt(xr, y, rail_mid),
        0.035, @steel
      )

      (0..count).each do |i|
        x = xl + TRUSS_W * i / count.to_f

        add_beam(
          entities,
          pt(x, y, z),
          pt(x, y, rail_top),
          0.035, @steel
        )
      end
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. THANG LEO AN TOAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '07 - Thang leo an toan')
    entities = group.entities

    x = LADDER_X
    y = LADDER_Y

    # Thanh doc
    [-0.25, 0.25].each do |dx|
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x + dx, y, LADDER_Z0),
        pt(x + dx, y, LADDER_Z1),
        0.045, @steel
      )
    end

    # Bac thang
    z = LADDER_Z0

    while z < LADDER_Z1
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x - 0.25, y, z),
        pt(x + 0.25, y, z),
        0.035, @steel_light
      )
      z += 0.30
    end

    # Long bao ve
    cage_y = y + 0.22
    cage_z = 4.0

    [-0.42, 0.42].each do |dx|
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x + dx, cage_y, cage_z),
        pt(x + dx, cage_y, LADDER_Z1),
        0.035, @steel
      )
    end

    z = cage_z

    while z < LADDER_Z1
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x - 0.42, cage_y, z),
        pt(x + 0.42, cage_y, z),
        0.03, @steel
      )
      z += 0.60
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. DEN CHIEU SANG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '08 - Den chieu sang')
    entities = group.entities

    spacing = BOARD_W.to_f / (LAMP_COUNT - 1)

    LAMP_COUNT.times do |i|
      x = -BOARD_W / 2.0 + i * spacing
      z = BOARD_Z + BOARD_H + 0.30

      # Tay do
      add_beam(
        entities,
        pt(x, -0.05, z),
        pt(x, -0.70, z + 0.30),
        0.045, @steel
      )

      # Than den
      add_box(
        entities,
        x - 0.20, -0.95, z + 0.20,
        0.40, 0.28, 0.12,
        @lamp
      )

      # Mat phat sang
      add_box(
        entities,
        x - 0.16, -0.94, z + 0.17,
        0.32, 0.22, 0.025,
        @lamp_glass
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. MAT DAT THAM KHAO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ground(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '00 - Mat dat tham khao')

    add_box(
      group.entities,
      -35, -20, -0.45,
      70, 40, 0.20,
      @ground
    )

    group
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. CAMERA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def setup_camera
    view = Sketchup.active_model.active_view

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      pt(27, -42, 20),
      pt(0, 0, 8),
      vec(0, 0, 1)
    )

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. TAO MO HINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create Outdoor Billboard 3D', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'BILLBOARD OUTDOOR - COMPLETE MODEL'
      )

      build_ground(root)
      build_foundation(root)
      build_base_plate(root)
      build_column(root)
      build_truss(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_catwalk(root)
      build_ladder(root)
      build_lights(root)

      model.commit_operation
      setup_camera

      puts 'Da tao xong mo hinh bien quang cao 3D.'
      puts "Mat bang bang quang cao: #{BOARD_W} x #{BOARD_H} m."
      puts "Cao do day bang: #{BOARD_Z} m."
      puts 'Luu mo hinh thanh file SKP neu can.'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "Loi khi tao mo hinh: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================
# HEALTHWAVE - 3D ADVERTISING SIGN / PANO
# SketchUp Ruby API
# Don vi: met
# Mo hinh bao gom:
# - Mong be tong, de va bu long neo
# - Cot thep tru tron va cot thep hop
# - Gian khung thep khong gian
# - San catwalk, lan can, thang leo an toan
# - Tam pano trang, vien inox
# - 4 nut bat inox trang tri
# - Logo HealthWave dang hinh hoc va chu noi 3D
#
# Luu file .rb, nap vao SketchUp Ruby Console de chay.
# ============================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module HealthWaveBillboard3D
  extend self

  MODEL = Sketchup.active_model

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO CHINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_W = 4.80
  SIGN_H = 3.00
  SIGN_T = 0.10
  SIGN_Z = 8.50

  POST_HEIGHT = 8.50
  POST_RADIUS = 0.18
  POST_BOX_W = 0.25

  FOUNDATION_W = 1.20
  FOUNDATION_D = 1.20
  FOUNDATION_H = 0.65

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.06
  FRAME_DEPTH = 0.18

  CATWALK_W = 0.65
  CATWALK_D = 0.70

  BOLT_RADIUS = 0.075
  BOLT_DEPTH = 0.055

  # Mat truoc pano quay ve phia -Y
  PANEL_FRONT_Y = -0.28

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. DON VI VA HINH HOC CO BAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def mm(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(mm(x), mm(y), mm(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = MODEL.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = material('HW Concrete', [170, 169, 161])
    @concrete_dark = material('HW Dark Concrete', [115, 117, 115])

    @steel = material('HW Steel', [130, 142, 150])
    @steel_dark = material('HW Dark Steel', [60, 68, 73])
    @stainless = material('HW Stainless Steel', [205, 211, 216])
    @chrome = material('HW Chrome', [225, 228, 230])

    @panel_white = material('HW White Acrylic Panel', [250, 250, 248])
    @panel_edge = material('HW Panel Edge', [160, 171, 178])

    @green_dark = material('HW Logo Dark Green', [0, 75, 48])
    @green = material('HW Logo Green', [90, 160, 45])
    @green_light = material('HW Logo Light Green', [165, 205, 65])
    @orange = material('HW Logo Orange', [238, 112, 24])
    @orange_light = material('HW Logo Light Orange', [255, 177, 28])

    @text_dark = material('HW Text Dark', [0, 37, 29])
    @ground = material('HW Ground', [205, 205, 202])
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. KHOI HOP
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    corners = [
      pt(x,      y,      z),
      pt(x + dx, y,      z),
      pt(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      pt(x,      y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(mm(dz))
    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 04. THANH HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, p1, p2, size, mat)
    direction = p2 - p1
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = vec(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    axis_x = direction.cross(reference)
    axis_x.normalize!

    axis_y = direction.cross(axis_x)
    axis_y.normalize!

    r = mm(size) / 2.0

    corners = [
      p1.offset(axis_x, r).offset(axis_y, r),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -r).offset(axis_y, r),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -r).offset(axis_y, -r),
      p1.offset(axis_x, r).offset(axis_y, -r)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 05. ONG TRON DUNG
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 32)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      mm(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(mm(height))
    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 06. TRU TRON THEP
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def horizontal_cylinder(entities, center, radius, length, direction, mat)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      direction,
      mm(radius),
      32
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(mm(length))
    face
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 07. MONG BE TONG VA BAN DE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundation(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Mong be tong va ban de')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -FOUNDATION_W / 2.0,
      -FOUNDATION_D / 2.0,
      -FOUNDATION_H,
      FOUNDATION_W,
      FOUNDATION_D,
      FOUNDATION_H,
      @concrete
    )

    # Be tong lot mong
    box(
      e,
      -FOUNDATION_W / 2.0 - 0.15,
      -FOUNDATION_D / 2.0 - 0.15,
      -FOUNDATION_H - 0.12,
      FOUNDATION_W + 0.30,
      FOUNDATION_D + 0.30,
      0.12,
      @concrete_dark
    )

    # Be co cot
    box(
      e,
      -0.35, -0.35, 0,
      0.70, 0.70, 0.25,
      @concrete
    )

    # Ban de cot thep
    box(
      e,
      -0.34, -0.34, 0.25,
      0.68, 0.68, 0.045,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Bu long neo va dai oc
    [-0.24, 0.24].each do |x|
      [-0.24, 0.24].each do |y|
        cylinder(e, x, y, 0.18, 0.025, 0.20, @steel_dark, 12)
        cylinder(e, x, y, 0.43, 0.045, 0.025, @chrome, 12)
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 08. COT THEP TRU TRON
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_round_post(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Cot thep tron')
    e = g.entities

    cylinder(
      e,
      0, 0, 0.295,
      POST_RADIUS,
      POST_HEIGHT,
      @steel,
      48
    )

    # Vong tang cung
    [0.45, 1.0, 4.0, 7.8].each do |z|
      cylinder(
        e,
        0, 0, z,
        POST_RADIUS + 0.018,
        0.045,
        @steel_dark,
        48
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 09. COT THEP HOP PHU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_box_post(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Cot thep hop phu')
    e = g.entities

    x = 0.55
    y = 0.15
    w = POST_BOX_W

    box(
      e,
      x - w / 2.0,
      y - w / 2.0,
      0.295,
      w, w,
      POST_HEIGHT - 0.10,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Nap dau cot
    box(
      e,
      x - w / 2.0 - 0.035,
      y - w / 2.0 - 0.035,
      POST_HEIGHT + 0.16,
      w + 0.07,
      w + 0.07,
      0.06,
      @stainless
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. KHUNG XUONG THEP SAU PANO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - Khung xuong thep pano')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_W / 2.0
    x2 = SIGN_W / 2.0
    z1 = SIGN_Z
    z2 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H

    yf = PANEL_FRONT_Y + SIGN_T
    yb = yf + FRAME_DEPTH

    # Khung chu nhat
    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z1), pt(x2, yb, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z2), pt(x2, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel)

    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z1), pt(x1, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x2, yb, z1), pt(x2, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel)

    # Thanh dung gia cuong
    [-1.6, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.6].each do |x|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, yb, z1 + 0.10),
        pt(x, yb, z2 - 0.10),
        0.035,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang gia cuong
    [z1 + 0.50, z1 + 1.50, z1 + 2.50].each do |z|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1 + 0.10, yb, z),
        pt(x2 - 0.10, yb, z),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Giang cheo
    4.times do |i|
      xa = x1 + i * SIGN_W / 4.0
      xb = xa + SIGN_W / 4.0

      beam(
        e,
        pt(xa, yb, z1),
        pt(xb, yb, z2),
        0.025,
        @steel_dark
      )

      beam(
        e,
        pt(xa, yb, z2),
        pt(xb, yb, z1),
        0.025,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. MAT PANO TRANG VA VIEN INOX
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - Pano trang va vien inox')
    e = g.entities

    # Tam pano
    box(
      e,
      -SIGN_W / 2.0,
      PANEL_FRONT_Y,
      SIGN_Z,
      SIGN_W,
      SIGN_T,
      SIGN_H,
      @panel_white
    )

    edge = 0.035
    y = PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.035

    # Vien tren va duoi
    box(
      e,
      -SIGN_W / 2.0,
      y,
      SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - edge,
      SIGN_W,
      0.035,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    box(
      e,
      -SIGN_W / 2.0,
      y,
      SIGN_Z,
      SIGN_W,
      0.035,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    # Vien trai va phai
    box(
      e,
      -SIGN_W / 2.0,
      y,
      SIGN_Z,
      edge,
      0.035,
      SIGN_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    box(
      e,
      SIGN_W / 2.0 - edge,
      y,
      SIGN_Z,
      edge,
      0.035,
      SIGN_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. NUT BAT INOX TRANG TRI
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_standoffs(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - Nut bat inox')
    e = g.entities

    positions = [
      [-SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.25, SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.25],
      [ SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.25, SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.25],
      [-SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.25, SIGN_Z + 0.25],
      [ SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.25, SIGN_Z + 0.25]
    ]

    positions.each do |x, z|
      # Chan cach tuong
      horizontal_cylinder(
        e,
        pt(x, PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.08, z),
        0.055,
        0.12,
        vec(0, 1, 0),
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Dau nut inox
      horizontal_cylinder(
        e,
        pt(x, PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.18, z),
        BOLT_RADIUS,
        BOLT_DEPTH,
        vec(0, 1, 0),
        @chrome
      )

      # Mat dau nut
      horizontal_cylinder(
        e,
        pt(x, PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.235, z),
        BOLT_RADIUS * 0.72,
        0.008,
        vec(0, 1, 0),
        @stainless
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. HINH HOC LOGO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_disc(entities, x, y, z, radius, depth, mat)
    horizontal_cylinder(
      entities,
      pt(x, y, z),
      radius,
      depth,
      vec(0, 1, 0),
      mat
    )
  end

  def add_flat_polygon(entities, points, y, mat, depth = 0.018)
    pts = points.map { |x, z| pt(x, y, z) }
    face = entities.add_face(pts)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat

    # Day vat lieu ra phia truoc pano
    face.pushpull(mm(depth))
    face
  end

  def add_arc_band(entities, cx, cz, outer_r, inner_r,
                   start_angle, end_angle, mat, y, segments = 36)
    points = []

    segments.times do |i|
      a = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * i / (segments - 1).to_f
      points << [cx + outer_r * Math.cos(a), cz + outer_r * Math.sin(a)]
    end

    segments.times do |i|
      a = end_angle - (end_angle - start_angle) * i / (segments - 1).to_f
      points << [cx + inner_r * Math.cos(a), cz + inner_r * Math.sin(a)]
    end

    add_flat_polygon(entities, points, y, mat, 0.025)
  end

  def build_logo(parent)
    g = group(parent, '07 - Logo HealthWave')
    e = g.entities

    cx = 0.0
    cz = SIGN_Z + 2.05
    y = PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.045

    # Vong cung cam lon
    add_arc_band(
      e, cx, cz, 0.79, 0.68,
      0.55, 5.15,
      @orange, y
    )

    # Vong cung xanh la ben phai
    add_arc_band(
      e, cx + 0.04, cz + 0.02,
      0.62, 0.53,
      -1.10, 1.25,
      @green, y - 0.012
    )

    # Vong cung xanh dam phia trong
    add_arc_band(
      e, cx + 0.02, cz + 0.01,
      0.49, 0.42,
      -1.20, 1.65,
      @green_dark, y - 0.020
    )

    # La trai
    add_flat_polygon(
      e,
      [
        [-0.40, cz + 0.30],
        [-0.17, cz + 0.20],
        [-0.04, cz - 0.05],
        [-0.12, cz - 0.32],
        [-0.28, cz - 0.08]
      ],
      y - 0.04,
      @green,
      0.035
    )

    # La phai
    add_flat_polygon(
      e,
      [
        [0.02, cz - 0.31],
        [0.22, cz - 0.17],
        [0.43, cz - 0.23],
        [0.25, cz - 0.38],
        [0.08, cz - 0.39]
      ],
      y - 0.05,
      @green_dark,
      0.035
    )

    # Than cay uon
    beam(
      e,
      pt(-0.02, y - 0.06, cz - 0.40),
      pt(0.05, y - 0.06, cz - 0.10),
      0.025,
      @green_dark
    )

    # Dau hinh tron mau cam
    add_disc(
      e,
      0.20, y - 0.07, cz - 0.02,
      0.075, 0.025, @orange
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. CHU NOI 3D
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_3d_text(entities, text, point, height, mat,
                  alignment = TextAlignCenter)
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_group.name = "Text - #{text}"

    text_entity = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      alignment,
      'Arial',
      false,
      true,
      mm(height),
      0.0,
      0.0,
      true,
      mm(height * 0.10)
    )

    text_entity.material = mat if text_entity.respond_to?(:material=)

    # Chu SketchUp tao tren mat phang XY, xoay de mat chu huong ra -Y
    transform = Geom::Transformation.new(point)
    rotate = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN,
      X_AXIS,
      90.degrees
    )

    text_group.transform!(transform * rotate)
    text_group
  end

  def build_text(parent)
    g = group(parent, '08 - Chu noi HealthWave')
    e = g.entities

    # Chu chinh
    add_3d_text(
      e,
      'HealthWave',
      pt(0.0, PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.10, SIGN_Z + 0.72),
      0.46,
      @text_dark,
      TextAlignCenter
    )

    # Dong tagline
    add_3d_text(
      e,
      'YOUR BUSINESS TAGLINE GOES HERE',
      pt(0.0, PANEL_FRONT_Y - 0.10, SIGN_Z + 0.42),
      0.135,
      @text_dark,
      TextAlignCenter
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = group(parent, '09 - San catwalk va lan can')
    e = g.entities

    z = SIGN_Z - 0.15
    x1 = -SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.15
    x2 = SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.15
    y1 = 0.15
    y2 = y1 + CATWALK_D

    # Mat san
    box(
      e,
      x1, y1, z,
      x2 - x1, CATWALK_D, 0.06,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z - 0.05),
        pt(x2, y, z - 0.05),
        0.05, @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can
    rail_z = z + 1.0

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, rail_z),
        pt(x2, y, rail_z),
        0.035, @steel
      )

      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z + 0.50),
        pt(x2, y, z + 0.50),
        0.025, @steel
      )

      12.times do |i|
        x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 11.0

        beam(
          e,
          pt(x, y, z),
          pt(x, y, rail_z),
          0.025, @steel
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. THANG LEO AN TOAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = group(parent, '10 - Thang leo an toan')
    e = g.entities

    x = 0.45
    y = 0.25
    z0 = 0.40
    z1 = SIGN_Z - 0.05

    # Thanh doc
    [-0.18, 0.18].each do |dx|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x + dx, y, z0),
        pt(x + dx, y, z1),
        0.035, @steel
      )
    end

    # Bac thang
    z = z0

    while z < z1
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x - 0.18, y, z),
        pt(x + 0.18, y, z),
        0.025, @steel_light
      )
      z += 0.28
    end

    # Long bao ve phia tren
    cage_y = y + 0.20
    cage_start = 3.0

    [-0.35, 0.35].each do |dx|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x + dx, cage_y, cage_start),
        pt(x + dx, cage_y, z1),
        0.025, @steel
      )
    end

    z = cage_start

    while z < z1
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x - 0.35, cage_y, z),
        pt(x + 0.35, cage_y, z),
        0.022, @steel
      )
      z += 0.55
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. MAT DAT THAM KHAO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ground(parent)
    g = group(parent, '00 - Mat dat tham khao')

    box(
      g.entities,
      -8, -6, -0.90,
      16, 12, 0.20,
      @ground
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 18. CAMERA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def setup_camera
    view = MODEL.active_view

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      pt(7.5, -12.0, 11.0),
      pt(0.0, 0.0, 6.5),
      vec(0, 0, 1)
    )

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 19. TAO TOAN BO MO HINH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    MODEL.start_operation('Create HealthWave Billboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = group(
        MODEL.active_entities,
        'HEALTHWAVE - COMPLETE SIGN MODEL'
      )

      build_ground(root)
      build_foundation(root)
      build_round_post(root)
      build_box_post(root)
      build_frame(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_standoffs(root)
      build_logo(root)
      build_text(root)
      build_catwalk(root)
      build_ladder(root)

      MODEL.commit_operation
      setup_camera

      puts 'HealthWave Billboard 3D created successfully.'

    rescue StandardError => error
      MODEL.abort_operation
      puts "Error: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - SKETCHUP RUBY GENERATOR
# Mo hinh bien quang cao ngoai troi theo anh tham chieu
#
# Thanh phan:
# 01. Mat dat va mong be tong
# 02. Hai cot tru thep tron va cot hop gia cuong
# 03. Ban de va bu long neo
# 04. Gian khung xuong thep khong gian
# 05. Tam pano quang cao trang
# 06. San catwalk va lan can bao ve
# 07. Thang leo an toan va long bao ve
# 08. Den chieu sang

require 'sketchup.rb'

module OutdoorBillboardGenerator
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  BOARD_W = 18.0
  BOARD_H = 8.0
  BOARD_T = 0.12
  BOARD_BOTTOM = 10.0

  BOARD_CENTER_X = 0.0
  BOARD_FRONT_Y = -0.35

  COLUMN_X_POSITIONS = [-5.5, 5.5].freeze
  COLUMN_Y = 0.45
  COLUMN_RADIUS = 0.48
  COLUMN_HEIGHT = BOARD_BOTTOM
  COLUMN_SEGMENTS = 48

  FOUNDATION_W = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_D = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_H = 1.2
  FOUNDATION_TOP = 0.0

  BASE_PLATE_W = 1.35
  BASE_PLATE_D = 1.35
  BASE_PLATE_T = 0.12

  TRUSS_W = 19.0
  TRUSS_H = 1.15
  TRUSS_D = 1.10
  TRUSS_BOTTOM = BOARD_BOTTOM - TRUSS_H
  TRUSS_PANEL = 0.85

  CATWALK_W = 0.75
  CATWALK_D = 0.85
  CATWALK_Z = TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.08

  LADDER_X = 5.0
  LADDER_Y = 0.0
  LADDER_BOTTOM = 0.35
  LADDER_TOP = BOARD_BOTTOM - 0.15
  LADDER_STEP = 0.30

  FRAME_BAR = 0.08
  FRAME_DIAGONAL = 0.045

  ADD_GROUND = true
  ADD_LIGHTS = true
  ADD_LADDER_CAGE = true
  ADD_RAISED_TEXT = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. DON VI, DIEM VA VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def point(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vector(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = make_material(
      'OB Concrete', [165, 165, 158]
    )
    @concrete_dark = make_material(
      'OB Concrete Dark', [120, 123, 122]
    )
    @steel = make_material(
      'OB Galvanized Steel', [116, 137, 151]
    )
    @steel_dark = make_material(
      'OB Structural Steel Dark', [40, 58, 72]
    )
    @steel_light = make_material(
      'OB Steel Highlights', [188, 199, 207]
    )
    @panel_white = make_material(
      'OB White Billboard', [250, 250, 248]
    )
    @panel_edge = make_material(
      'OB Panel Edge', [160, 174, 184]
    )
    @lamp_material = make_material(
      'OB Lamp Housing', [42, 48, 52]
    )
    @lamp_glass = make_material(
      'OB Lamp Glass', [255, 243, 210]
    )
    @text_material = make_material(
      'OB Raised Lettering', [30, 45, 42]
    )
    @ground_material = make_material(
      'OB Ground', [155, 155, 146]
    )
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    vertices = [
      point(x,      y,      z),
      point(x + dx, y,      z),
      point(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      point(x,      y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(vertices)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(dz))

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 04. THANH THEP HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, p1, p2, width, mat)
    direction = p2 - p1
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = vector(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vector(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    axis_x = direction.cross(reference)
    axis_x.normalize!

    axis_y = direction.cross(axis_x)
    axis_y.normalize!

    radius = m(width) / 2.0

    vertices = [
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, -radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, -radius)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(vertices)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 05. ONG TRON THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 32)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      point(x, y, z),
      vector(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))

    face
  end

  def add_horizontal_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, length, mat)
    center = point(x, y, z)

    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      vector(0, 1, 0),
      m(radius),
      32
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(length))

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 06. MONG BE TONG VA BAN DE COT
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Concrete Foundations')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Be tong lot mong
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0 - 0.15,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0 - 0.15,
        -FOUNDATION_H - 0.15,
        FOUNDATION_W + 0.30,
        FOUNDATION_D + 0.30,
        0.15,
        @concrete_dark
      )

      # Mong chinh
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_H,
        FOUNDATION_W,
        FOUNDATION_D,
        FOUNDATION_H,
        @concrete
      )

      # Be co cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.85,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.85,
        0.0,
        1.70,
        1.70,
        0.30,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - BASE_PLATE_W / 2.0,
        COLUMN_Y - BASE_PLATE_D / 2.0,
        0.30,
        BASE_PLATE_W,
        BASE_PLATE_D,
        BASE_PLATE_T,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dx|
        [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dy|
          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.18,
            0.035,
            0.30,
            @steel_dark,
            12
          )

          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.57,
            0.065,
            0.035,
            @steel_light,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 07. HAI COT THEP TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_columns(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Twin Steel Columns')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Than cot chinh
      add_cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        COLUMN_Y,
        0.32,
        COLUMN_RADIUS,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.32,
        @steel_dark,
        COLUMN_SEGMENTS
      )

      # Dai tang cung
      [0.55, 1.10, 4.0, 7.0, 9.2].each do |z|
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          COLUMN_Y,
          z,
          COLUMN_RADIUS + 0.035,
          0.07,
          @steel,
          COLUMN_SEGMENTS
        )
      end

      # Ban ma dau cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.70,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.65,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.15,
        1.40,
        1.30,
        0.20,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 08. COT HOP VA GIANG LIEN KET
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_secondary_posts(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Box Posts and Bracing')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Cot hop phia sau cot tron
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.13,
        COLUMN_Y + 0.48,
        0.35,
        0.26,
        0.26,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.50,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Giang lien ket tren cot
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x - 0.35, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.8),
        point(x + 0.35, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 9.5),
        0.07,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Giang lien ket hai cot
    add_beam(
      e,
      point(COLUMN_X_POSITIONS[0], COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.9),
      point(COLUMN_X_POSITIONS[1], COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.9),
      0.10,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 09. GIAN KHUNG XUONG THEP KHONG GIAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_truss(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Spatial Steel Truss')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    x2 = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    z1 = TRUSS_BOTTOM
    z2 = BOARD_BOTTOM

    y1 = BOARD_FRONT_Y + BOARD_T + 0.15
    y2 = y1 + TRUSS_D

    panels = (TRUSS_W / TRUSS_PANEL).ceil
    step = TRUSS_W / panels.to_f

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      # Thanh bien tren va duoi
      add_beam(e, point(x1, y, z1), point(x2, y, z1), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
      add_beam(e, point(x1, y, z2), point(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)

      # Thanh dung va thanh cheo
      panels.times do |i|
        xa = x1 + i * step
        xb = xa + step

        add_beam(
          e,
          point(xa, y, z1),
          point(xa, y, z2),
          0.045,
          @steel
        )

        if i.even?
          add_beam(
            e,
            point(xa, y, z1),
            point(xb, y, z2),
            FRAME_DIAGONAL,
            @steel
          )
        else
          add_beam(
            e,
            point(xa, y, z2),
            point(xb, y, z1),
            FRAME_DIAGONAL,
            @steel
          )
        end
      end

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x2, y, z1),
        point(x2, y, z2),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang noi hai mat gian
    (0..panels).each do |i|
      x = x1 + i * step

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z1),
        point(x, y2, z1),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z2),
        point(x, y2, z2),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Giang cheo khong gian
    panels.times do |i|
      next unless i.even?

      xa = x1 + i * step
      xb = xa + step

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(xa, y1, z1),
        point(xb, y2, z2),
        FRAME_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(xa, y2, z1),
        point(xb, y1, z2),
        FRAME_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Gia cuong dung o hai dau pano
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z1),
        point(x, y2, z2),
        0.07,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y2, z1),
        point(x, y1, z2),
        0.07,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. MAT PANO QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - White Billboard Panel')
    e = g.entities

    # Tam pano trang
    add_box(
      e,
      BOARD_CENTER_X - BOARD_W / 2.0,
      BOARD_FRONT_Y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      BOARD_W,
      BOARD_T,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_white
    )

    # Vien kim loai
    edge = 0.07
    frame_y = BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.025

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_H,
      BOARD_W + 2.0 * edge,
      0.06,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM - edge,
      BOARD_W + 2.0 * edge,
      0.06,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      edge,
      0.06,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      BOARD_W / 2.0,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      edge,
      0.06,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Catwalk and Guardrails')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    x2 = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    y1 = BOARD_FRONT_Y + BOARD_T + 0.15
    y2 = y1 + CATWALK_D

    z = CATWALK_Z

    # Mat san catwalk
    add_box(
      e,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      TRUSS_W,
      CATWALK_D,
      0.07,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, z - 0.05),
        point(x2, y, z - 0.05),
        0.07,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Dam ngang
    panels = (TRUSS_W / 1.5).ceil

    (0..panels).each do |i|
      x = x1 + TRUSS_W * i / panels.to_f

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z - 0.05),
        point(x, y2, z - 0.05),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can
    rail_top = z + 1.05
    rail_mid = z + 0.52

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, rail_top),
        point(x2, y, rail_top),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, rail_mid),
        point(x2, y, rail_mid),
        0.03,
        @steel
      )

      (0..panels).each do |i|
        x = x1 + TRUSS_W * i / panels.to_f

        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x, y, z),
          point(x, y, rail_top),
          0.03,
          @steel
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. THANG LEO AN TOAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '07 - Safety Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = LADDER_X
    y = LADDER_Y

    # Hai thanh doc
    [-0.22, 0.22].each do |dx|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x + dx, y, LADDER_BOTTOM),
        point(x + dx, y, LADDER_TOP),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Bac thang
    z = LADDER_BOTTOM

    while z <= LADDER_TOP
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x - 0.22, y, z),
        point(x + 0.22, y, z),
        0.03,
        @steel_light
      )

      z += LADDER_STEP
    end

    if ADD_LADDER_CAGE
      cage_y = y + 0.22
      cage_z = 3.0

      [-0.43, 0.43].each do |dx|
        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x + dx, cage_y, cage_z),
          point(x + dx, cage_y, LADDER_TOP),
          0.03,
          @steel_dark
        )
      end

      z = cage_z

      while z <= LADDER_TOP
        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x - 0.43, cage_y, z),
          point(x + 0.43, cage_y, z),
          0.025,
          @steel
        )

        z += 0.60
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. DEN CHIEU SANG TREN DINH PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '08 - Billboard Lights')
    e = g.entities

    count = 8
    spacing = BOARD_W / (count - 1).to_f

    count.times do |i|
      x = -BOARD_W / 2.0 + i * spacing
      z = BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_H + 0.18

      # Tay do den
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, BOARD_FRONT_Y + 0.05, z),
        point(x, BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.55, z + 0.18),
        0.035,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Than den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.18,
        BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.80,
        z + 0.10,
        0.36,
        0.24,
        0.10,
        @lamp_material
      )

      # Mat den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.15,
        BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.79,
        z + 0.075,
        0.30,
        0.20,
        0.025,
        @lamp_glass
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. CHU NOI 3D TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_raised_text(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '09 - Raised Billboard Text')
    e = g.entities

    text_group = e.add_group
    text_group.name = 'Raised Text - Billboard'

    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      'OUTDOOR ADVERTISING',
      TextAlignCenter,
      'Arial',
      false,
      true,
      m(0.55),
      0.0,
      0.0,
      true,
      m(0.04)
    )

    text_group.entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

      entity.material = @text_material
    end

    # Xoay mat chu huong ve phia truoc (-Y)
    transform = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      point(0, BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.15, BOARD_BOTTOM + 3.2)
    )

    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN,
      X_AXIS,
      90.degrees
    )

    text_group.transform!(transform * rotation)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. MAT DAT THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ground(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Ground')
    e = g.entities

    add_box(
      e,
      -25.0, -20.0, -1.45,
      50.0, 40.0, 0.20,
      @ground_material
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. CAMERA VA HIEN THI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def setup_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      point(25, -42, 22),
      point(0, 0, 8),
      vector(0, 0, 1)
    )

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. TAO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Outdoor Billboard Generator', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - COMPLETE MODEL'
      )

      build_ground(root) if ADD_GROUND
      build_foundations(root)
      build_columns(root)
      build_secondary_posts(root)
      build_truss(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_catwalk(root)
      build_ladder(root)
      build_lights(root) if ADD_LIGHTS
      build_raised_text(root) if ADD_RAISED_TEXT

      model.commit_operation
      setup_camera

      puts '============================================'
      puts 'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Panel: #{BOARD_W}m x #{BOARD_H}m"
      puts "Panel bottom: #{BOARD_BOTTOM}m"
      puts 'Groups are organized by structural component.'
      puts 'Save the model as SKP when ready.'
      puts '============================================'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "Billboard generation failed: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - SKETCHUP RUBY GENERATOR
# Mo hinh bien quang cao ngoai troi theo anh tham chieu
#
# Thanh phan:

require 'sketchup.rb'

module OutdoorBillboardGenerator
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  BOARD_W = 18.0
  BOARD_H = 8.0
  BOARD_T = 0.12
  BOARD_BOTTOM = 10.0

  BOARD_CENTER_X = 0.0
  BOARD_FRONT_Y = -0.35

  COLUMN_X_POSITIONS = [-5.5, 5.5].freeze
  COLUMN_Y = 0.45
  COLUMN_RADIUS = 0.48
  COLUMN_HEIGHT = BOARD_BOTTOM
  COLUMN_SEGMENTS = 48

  FOUNDATION_W = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_D = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_H = 1.2
  FOUNDATION_TOP = 0.0

  BASE_PLATE_W = 1.35
  BASE_PLATE_D = 1.35
  BASE_PLATE_T = 0.12

  TRUSS_W = 19.0
  TRUSS_H = 1.15
  TRUSS_D = 1.10
  TRUSS_BOTTOM = BOARD_BOTTOM - TRUSS_H
  TRUSS_PANEL = 0.85

  CATWALK_W = 0.75
  CATWALK_D = 0.85
  CATWALK_Z = TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.08

  LADDER_X = 5.0
  LADDER_Y = 0.0
  LADDER_BOTTOM = 0.35
  LADDER_TOP = BOARD_BOTTOM - 0.15
  LADDER_STEP = 0.30

  FRAME_BAR = 0.08
  FRAME_DIAGONAL = 0.045

  ADD_GROUND = true
  ADD_LIGHTS = true
  ADD_LADDER_CAGE = true
  ADD_RAISED_TEXT = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. DON VI, DIEM VA VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def point(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vector(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = make_material(
      'OB Concrete', [165, 165, 158]
    )
    @concrete_dark = make_material(
      'OB Concrete Dark', [120, 123, 122]
    )
    @steel = make_material(
      'OB Galvanized Steel', [116, 137, 151]
    )
    @steel_dark = make_material(
      'OB Structural Steel Dark', [40, 58, 72]
    )
    @steel_light = make_material(
      'OB Steel Highlights', [188, 199, 207]
    )
    @panel_white = make_material(
      'OB White Billboard', [250, 250, 248]
    )
    @panel_edge = make_material(
      'OB Panel Edge', [160, 174, 184]
    )
    @lamp_material = make_material(
      'OB Lamp Housing', [42, 48, 52]
    )
    @lamp_glass = make_material(
      'OB Lamp Glass', [255, 243, 210]
    )
    @text_material = make_material(
      'OB Raised Lettering', [30, 45, 42]
    )
    @ground_material = make_material(
      'OB Ground', [155, 155, 146]
    )
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    vertices = [
      point(x,      y,      z),
      point(x + dx, y,      z),
      point(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      point(x,      y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(vertices)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(dz))

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 04. THANH THEP HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, p1, p2, width, mat)
    direction = p2 - p1
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = vector(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vector(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    axis_x = direction.cross(reference)
    axis_x.normalize!

    axis_y = direction.cross(axis_x)
    axis_y.normalize!

    radius = m(width) / 2.0

    vertices = [
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, -radius).offset(axis_y, -radius),
      p1.offset(axis_x, radius).offset(axis_y, -radius)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(vertices)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 05. ONG TRON THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 32)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      point(x, y, z),
      vector(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))

    face
  end

  def add_horizontal_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, length, mat)
    center = point(x, y, z)

    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      vector(0, 1, 0),
      m(radius),
      32
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(length))

    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 06. MONG BE TONG VA BAN DE COT
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Concrete Foundations')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Be tong lot mong
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0 - 0.15,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0 - 0.15,
        -FOUNDATION_H - 0.15,
        FOUNDATION_W + 0.30,
        FOUNDATION_D + 0.30,
        0.15,
        @concrete_dark
      )

      # Mong chinh
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_D / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_H,
        FOUNDATION_W,
        FOUNDATION_D,
        FOUNDATION_H,
        @concrete
      )

      # Be co cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.85,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.85,
        0.0,
        1.70,
        1.70,
        0.30,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - BASE_PLATE_W / 2.0,
        COLUMN_Y - BASE_PLATE_D / 2.0,
        0.30,
        BASE_PLATE_W,
        BASE_PLATE_D,
        BASE_PLATE_T,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dx|
        [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dy|
          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.18,
            0.035,
            0.30,
            @steel_dark,
            12
          )

          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.57,
            0.065,
            0.035,
            @steel_light,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 07. HAI COT THEP TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_columns(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Twin Steel Columns')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Than cot chinh
      add_cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        COLUMN_Y,
        0.32,
        COLUMN_RADIUS,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.32,
        @steel_dark,
        COLUMN_SEGMENTS
      )

      # Dai tang cung
      [0.55, 1.10, 4.0, 7.0, 9.2].each do |z|
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          COLUMN_Y,
          z,
          COLUMN_RADIUS + 0.035,
          0.07,
          @steel,
          COLUMN_SEGMENTS
        )
      end

      # Ban ma dau cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.70,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.65,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.15,
        1.40,
        1.30,
        0.20,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 08. COT HOP VA GIANG LIEN KET
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_secondary_posts(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Box Posts and Bracing')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X_POSITIONS.each do |x|
      # Cot hop phia sau cot tron
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.13,
        COLUMN_Y + 0.48,
        0.35,
        0.26,
        0.26,
        COLUMN_HEIGHT - 0.50,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Giang lien ket tren cot
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x - 0.35, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.8),
        point(x + 0.35, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 9.5),
        0.07,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Giang lien ket hai cot
    add_beam(
      e,
      point(COLUMN_X_POSITIONS[0], COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.9),
      point(COLUMN_X_POSITIONS[1], COLUMN_Y + 0.48, 8.9),
      0.10,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 09. GIAN KHUNG XUONG THEP KHONG GIAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_truss(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Spatial Steel Truss')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    x2 = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    z1 = TRUSS_BOTTOM
    z2 = BOARD_BOTTOM

    y1 = BOARD_FRONT_Y + BOARD_T + 0.15
    y2 = y1 + TRUSS_D

    panels = (TRUSS_W / TRUSS_PANEL).ceil
    step = TRUSS_W / panels.to_f

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      # Thanh bien tren va duoi
      add_beam(e, point(x1, y, z1), point(x2, y, z1), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
      add_beam(e, point(x1, y, z2), point(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)

      # Thanh dung va thanh cheo
      panels.times do |i|
        xa = x1 + i * step
        xb = xa + step

        add_beam(
          e,
          point(xa, y, z1),
          point(xa, y, z2),
          0.045,
          @steel
        )

        if i.even?
          add_beam(
            e,
            point(xa, y, z1),
            point(xb, y, z2),
            FRAME_DIAGONAL,
            @steel
          )
        else
          add_beam(
            e,
            point(xa, y, z2),
            point(xb, y, z1),
            FRAME_DIAGONAL,
            @steel
          )
        end
      end

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x2, y, z1),
        point(x2, y, z2),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang noi hai mat gian
    (0..panels).each do |i|
      x = x1 + i * step

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z1),
        point(x, y2, z1),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z2),
        point(x, y2, z2),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Giang cheo khong gian
    panels.times do |i|
      next unless i.even?

      xa = x1 + i * step
      xb = xa + step

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(xa, y1, z1),
        point(xb, y2, z2),
        FRAME_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(xa, y2, z1),
        point(xb, y1, z2),
        FRAME_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Gia cuong dung o hai dau pano
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z1),
        point(x, y2, z2),
        0.07,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y2, z1),
        point(x, y1, z2),
        0.07,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. MAT PANO QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - White Billboard Panel')
    e = g.entities

    # Tam pano trang
    add_box(
      e,
      BOARD_CENTER_X - BOARD_W / 2.0,
      BOARD_FRONT_Y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      BOARD_W,
      BOARD_T,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_white
    )

    # Vien kim loai
    edge = 0.07
    frame_y = BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.025

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_H,
      BOARD_W + 2.0 * edge,
      0.06,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM - edge,
      BOARD_W + 2.0 * edge,
      0.06,
      edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      -BOARD_W / 2.0 - edge,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      edge,
      0.06,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      BOARD_W / 2.0,
      frame_y,
      BOARD_BOTTOM,
      edge,
      0.06,
      BOARD_H,
      @panel_edge
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Catwalk and Guardrails')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -TRUSS_W / 2.0
    x2 = TRUSS_W / 2.0

    y1 = BOARD_FRONT_Y + BOARD_T + 0.15
    y2 = y1 + CATWALK_D

    z = CATWALK_Z

    # Mat san catwalk
    add_box(
      e,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      TRUSS_W,
      CATWALK_D,
      0.07,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, z - 0.05),
        point(x2, y, z - 0.05),
        0.07,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Dam ngang
    panels = (TRUSS_W / 1.5).ceil

    (0..panels).each do |i|
      x = x1 + TRUSS_W * i / panels.to_f

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, y1, z - 0.05),
        point(x, y2, z - 0.05),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can
    rail_top = z + 1.05
    rail_mid = z + 0.52

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, rail_top),
        point(x2, y, rail_top),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x1, y, rail_mid),
        point(x2, y, rail_mid),
        0.03,
        @steel
      )

      (0..panels).each do |i|
        x = x1 + TRUSS_W * i / panels.to_f

        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x, y, z),
          point(x, y, rail_top),
          0.03,
          @steel
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. THANG LEO AN TOAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '07 - Safety Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = LADDER_X
    y = LADDER_Y

    # Hai thanh doc
    [-0.22, 0.22].each do |dx|
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x + dx, y, LADDER_BOTTOM),
        point(x + dx, y, LADDER_TOP),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Bac thang
    z = LADDER_BOTTOM

    while z <= LADDER_TOP
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x - 0.22, y, z),
        point(x + 0.22, y, z),
        0.03,
        @steel_light
      )

      z += LADDER_STEP
    end

    if ADD_LADDER_CAGE
      cage_y = y + 0.22
      cage_z = 3.0

      [-0.43, 0.43].each do |dx|
        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x + dx, cage_y, cage_z),
          point(x + dx, cage_y, LADDER_TOP),
          0.03,
          @steel_dark
        )
      end

      z = cage_z

      while z <= LADDER_TOP
        add_beam(
          e,
          point(x - 0.43, cage_y, z),
          point(x + 0.43, cage_y, z),
          0.025,
          @steel
        )

        z += 0.60
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. DEN CHIEU SANG TREN DINH PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '08 - Billboard Lights')
    e = g.entities

    count = 8
    spacing = BOARD_W / (count - 1).to_f

    count.times do |i|
      x = -BOARD_W / 2.0 + i * spacing
      z = BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_H + 0.18

      # Tay do den
      add_beam(
        e,
        point(x, BOARD_FRONT_Y + 0.05, z),
        point(x, BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.55, z + 0.18),
        0.035,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Than den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.18,
        BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.80,
        z + 0.10,
        0.36,
        0.24,
        0.10,
        @lamp_material
      )

      # Mat den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.15,
        BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.79,
        z + 0.075,
        0.30,
        0.20,
        0.025,
        @lamp_glass
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. CHU NOI 3D TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_raised_text(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '09 - Raised Billboard Text')
    e = g.entities

    text_group = e.add_group
    text_group.name = 'Raised Text - Billboard'

    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      'OUTDOOR ADVERTISING',
      TextAlignCenter,
      'Arial',
      false,
      true,
      m(0.55),
      0.0,
      0.0,
      true,
      m(0.04)
    )

    text_group.entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

      entity.material = @text_material
    end

    # Xoay mat chu huong ve phia truoc (-Y)
    transform = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      point(0, BOARD_FRONT_Y - 0.15, BOARD_BOTTOM + 3.2)
    )

    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN,
      X_AXIS,
      90.degrees
    )

    text_group.transform!(transform * rotation)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. MAT DAT THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ground(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Ground')
    e = g.entities

    add_box(
      e,
      -25.0, -20.0, -1.45,
      50.0, 40.0, 0.20,
      @ground_material
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. CAMERA VA HIEN THI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def setup_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      point(25, -42, 22),
      point(0, 0, 8),
      vector(0, 0, 1)
    )

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. TAO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Outdoor Billboard Generator', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - COMPLETE MODEL'
      )

      build_ground(root) if ADD_GROUND
      build_foundations(root)
      build_columns(root)
      build_secondary_posts(root)
      build_truss(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_catwalk(root)
      build_ladder(root)
      build_lights(root) if ADD_LIGHTS
      build_raised_text(root) if ADD_RAISED_TEXT

      model.commit_operation
      setup_camera

      puts '============================================'
      puts 'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Panel: #{BOARD_W}m x #{BOARD_H}m"
      puts "Panel bottom: #{BOARD_BOTTOM}m"
      puts 'Groups are organized by structural component.'
      puts 'Save the model as SKP when ready.'
      puts '============================================'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "Billboard generation failed: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
