require 'sketchup.rb'

module OutdoorBillboard3D
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 01. THONG SO CHINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  BOARD_WIDTH  = 18.0
  BOARD_HEIGHT = 5.8
  BOARD_DEPTH  = 0.18
  BOARD_BOTTOM = 10.0
  BOARD_CENTER_X = 0.0

  FRONT_Y = -0.45
  BACK_Y  = FRONT_Y + BOARD_DEPTH

  COLUMN_X = [-5.4, 5.4].freeze
  COLUMN_Y = 0.55
  COLUMN_RADIUS = 0.48
  COLUMN_BASE_Z = 0.0
  COLUMN_TOP_Z = BOARD_BOTTOM - 0.15

  FOUNDATION_WIDTH  = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_DEPTH  = 2.4
  FOUNDATION_HEIGHT = 1.15

  TRUSS_WIDTH = 19.0
  TRUSS_HEIGHT = 1.0
  TRUSS_DEPTH = 1.15
  TRUSS_BOTTOM = BOARD_BOTTOM - TRUSS_HEIGHT
  TRUSS_PANEL_COUNT = 24

  CATWALK_WIDTH = 19.6
  CATWALK_DEPTH = 0.95
  CATWALK_Z = TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.12

  LADDER_X = 5.95
  LADDER_Y = 0.45
  LADDER_BOTTOM = 0.35
  LADDER_TOP = BOARD_BOTTOM - 0.05
  LADDER_STEP = 0.30

  BAR_MAIN = 0.075
  BAR_SECONDARY = 0.045
  BAR_DIAGONAL = 0.035

  CREATE_GROUND = true
  CREATE_ROAD = true
  CREATE_LIGHTS = true
  CREATE_LADDER_CAGE = true
  CREATE_RAISED_TEXT = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 02. DON VI VA HAM HINH HOC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def u(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def p3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(u(x), u(y), u(z))
  end

  def v3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    group = parent.add_group
    group.name = name
    group
  end

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = make_material('OB3D Concrete', [158, 158, 151])
    @concrete_dark = make_material('OB3D Concrete Dark', [111, 116, 118])

    @steel = make_material('OB3D Galvanized Steel', [143, 163, 175])
    @steel_dark = make_material('OB3D Structural Steel', [43, 59, 72])
    @steel_light = make_material('OB3D Steel Highlight', [204, 216, 223])
    @steel_blue = make_material('OB3D Blue Steel', [91, 132, 157])

    @panel = make_material('OB3D White Billboard', [255, 255, 253])
    @panel_edge = make_material('OB3D Panel Aluminium Edge', [179, 191, 198])

    @lamp_body = make_material('OB3D Lamp Housing', [53, 61, 67])
    @lamp_glass = make_material('OB3D Lamp Glass', [255, 244, 210])

    @road = make_material('OB3D Asphalt', [90, 92, 94])
    @road_line = make_material('OB3D Road Markings', [245, 245, 237])
    @grass = make_material('OB3D Green Ground', [112, 151, 78])
    @text_mat = make_material('OB3D Raised Text', [34, 49, 56])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 03. KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    corners = [
      p3(x,      y,      z),
      p3(x + dx, y,      z),
      p3(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      p3(x,      y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(u(dz))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 04. THANH THEP HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, start_point, end_point, width, mat)
    direction = end_point - start_point
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = v3(0, 0, 1)
    reference = v3(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    axis_x = direction.cross(reference)
    axis_x.normalize!

    axis_y = direction.cross(axis_x)
    axis_y.normalize!

    half = u(width) / 2.0

    vertices = [
      start_point.offset(axis_x, half).offset(axis_y, half),
      start_point.offset(axis_x, -half).offset(axis_y, half),
      start_point.offset(axis_x, -half).offset(axis_y, -half),
      start_point.offset(axis_x, half).offset(axis_y, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(vertices)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 05. ONG TRON THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 36)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      p3(x, y, z),
      v3(0, 0, 1),
      u(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(u(height))
    face
  end

  def add_horizontal_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, length, mat)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      p3(x, y, z),
      v3(0, 1, 0),
      u(radius),
      24
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(u(length))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 06. MAT DUONG VA CANH QUAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ground(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Ground and Road')
    e = g.entities

    if CREATE_GROUND
      add_box(
        e, -30, -25, -1.35,
        60, 50, 0.25,
        @grass
      )
    end

    if CREATE_ROAD
      # Mat duong nam truoc bien
      add_box(
        e, -7.0, -28.0, -1.08,
        14.0, 35.0, 0.05,
        @road
      )

      # Le duong hai ben
      add_box(
        e, -7.35, -28.0, -1.02,
        0.25, 35.0, 0.06,
        @road_line
      )

      add_box(
        e, 7.10, -28.0, -1.02,
        0.25, 35.0, 0.06,
        @road_line
      )

      # Vach dut net tim duong
      18.times do |i|
        y = -27.0 + i * 1.75
        add_box(
          e, -0.09, y, -1.015,
          0.18, 0.85, 0.025,
          @road_line
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 07. MONG BE TONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Reinforced Concrete Foundations')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X.each do |x|
      # Lop be tong lot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.18,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.18,
        -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT - 0.15,
        FOUNDATION_WIDTH + 0.36,
        FOUNDATION_DEPTH + 0.36,
        0.15,
        @concrete_dark
      )

      # Mong chinh
      add_box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_WIDTH / 2.0,
        COLUMN_Y - FOUNDATION_DEPTH / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        FOUNDATION_WIDTH,
        FOUNDATION_DEPTH,
        FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        @concrete
      )

      # Be co cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.78,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.78,
        0.0,
        1.56,
        1.56,
        0.32,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de thep
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.68,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.68,
        0.32,
        1.36,
        1.36,
        0.10,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dx|
        [-0.48, 0.48].each do |dy|
          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.22,
            0.035,
            0.28,
            @steel_dark,
            12
          )

          add_cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            COLUMN_Y + dy,
            0.43,
            0.065,
            0.035,
            @steel_light,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 08. HAI COT THEP TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_columns(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Twin Round Steel Columns')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X.each do |x|
      # Cot tron chinh
      add_cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        COLUMN_Y,
        0.42,
        COLUMN_RADIUS,
        COLUMN_TOP_Z - 0.42,
        @steel,
        48
      )

      # Dai thep tang cung
      [0.55, 1.10, 4.0, 7.0, 9.25].each do |z|
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          COLUMN_Y,
          z,
          COLUMN_RADIUS + 0.035,
          0.06,
          @steel_dark,
          48
        )
      end

      # Nap cot tren
      add_cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        COLUMN_Y,
        COLUMN_TOP_Z - 0.05,
        COLUMN_RADIUS + 0.025,
        0.12,
        @steel_light,
        48
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 09. COT HOP VA KHUNG LIEN KET
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_box_posts(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Box Posts and Connections')
    e = g.entities

    COLUMN_X.each do |x|
      # Cot hop phia sau tru tron
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.15,
        COLUMN_Y + 0.45,
        0.42,
        0.30,
        0.30,
        COLUMN_TOP_Z - 0.42,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Ban ma dau cot
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.70,
        COLUMN_Y - 0.55,
        TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.12,
        1.40,
        1.20,
        0.18,
        @steel_blue
      )

      # Gia tam ngang
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x - 0.75, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.1),
        p3(x + 0.75, COLUMN_Y + 0.48, TRUSS_BOTTOM - 0.1),
        0.12,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. KHUNG GIAN THEP KHONG GIAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_truss(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Spatial Steel Truss')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -TRUSS_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = TRUSS_WIDTH / 2.0
    y1 = BACK_Y + 0.12
    y2 = y1 + TRUSS_DEPTH
    z1 = TRUSS_BOTTOM
    z2 = BOARD_BOTTOM

    panels = TRUSS_PANEL_COUNT
    step = TRUSS_WIDTH / panels.to_f

    # Hai mat gian truoc va sau
    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z1), BAR_MAIN, @steel_dark)
      add_beam(e, p3(x1, y, z2), p3(x2, y, z2), BAR_MAIN, @steel_dark)

      panels.times do |i|
        xa = x1 + i * step
        xb = xa + step

        add_beam(
          e,
          p3(xa, y, z1),
          p3(xa, y, z2),
          BAR_SECONDARY,
          @steel
        )

        if i.even?
          add_beam(
            e,
            p3(xa, y, z1),
            p3(xb, y, z2),
            BAR_DIAGONAL,
            @steel_light
          )
        else
          add_beam(
            e,
            p3(xa, y, z2),
            p3(xb, y, z1),
            BAR_DIAGONAL,
            @steel_light
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Thanh noi hai mat gian theo chieu sau
    (0..panels).each do |i|
      x = x1 + i * step

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z1),
        p3(x, y2, z1),
        BAR_SECONDARY,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z2),
        p3(x, y2, z2),
        BAR_SECONDARY,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Gian cheo theo chieu sau tao ket cau khong gian
    panels.times do |i|
      next unless i.even?

      xa = x1 + i * step
      xb = xa + step

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(xa, y1, z1),
        p3(xb, y2, z2),
        BAR_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(xa, y2, z1),
        p3(xb, y1, z2),
        BAR_DIAGONAL,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Khung dung hai dau
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z1),
        p3(x, y1, z2),
        BAR_MAIN,
        @steel_dark
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y2, z1),
        p3(x, y2, z2),
        BAR_MAIN,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. TAM PANO TRANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - White Billboard Face')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -BOARD_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = BOARD_WIDTH / 2.0
    z1 = BOARD_BOTTOM
    z2 = BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_HEIGHT

    # Tam pano chinh
    add_box(
      e,
      x1,
      FRONT_Y,
      z1,
      BOARD_WIDTH,
      BOARD_DEPTH,
      BOARD_HEIGHT,
      @panel
    )

    # Khung vien nhom
    edge = 0.07
    ey = FRONT_Y - 0.04

    add_box(
      e, x1 - edge, ey, z2,
      BOARD_WIDTH + 2 * edge, 0.07, edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e, x1 - edge, ey, z1 - edge,
      BOARD_WIDTH + 2 * edge, 0.07, edge,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e, x1 - edge, ey, z1,
      edge, 0.07, BOARD_HEIGHT,
      @panel_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e, x2, ey, z1,
      edge, 0.07, BOARD_HEIGHT,
      @panel_edge
    )

    # Thanh gia cuong phia sau pano
    frame_y = BACK_Y + 0.02

    add_beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, frame_y, z1 + 0.12),
      p3(x2, frame_y, z1 + 0.12),
      0.08,
      @steel_dark
    )

    add_beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, frame_y, z2 - 0.12),
      p3(x2, frame_y, z2 - 0.12),
      0.08,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Catwalk Platform and Guardrails')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -CATWALK_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = CATWALK_WIDTH / 2.0
    y1 = BACK_Y + 0.05
    y2 = y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH
    z = CATWALK_Z

    # Mat san kim loai
    add_box(
      e,
      x1, y1, z,
      CATWALK_WIDTH, CATWALK_DEPTH, 0.08,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc hai ben
    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x1, y, z - 0.04),
        p3(x2, y, z - 0.04),
        0.08,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Dam ngang catwalk
    divisions = 24

    (0..divisions).each do |i|
      x = x1 + CATWALK_WIDTH * i / divisions.to_f

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z - 0.04),
        p3(x, y2, z - 0.04),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can o phia ngoai
    rail_z = z + 1.05
    mid_z = z + 0.52

    [y1, y2].each do |y|
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x1, y, rail_z),
        p3(x2, y, rail_z),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )

      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x1, y, mid_z),
        p3(x2, y, mid_z),
        0.03,
        @steel
      )

      (0..divisions).each do |i|
        x = x1 + CATWALK_WIDTH * i / divisions.to_f

        add_beam(
          e,
          p3(x, y, z),
          p3(x, y, rail_z),
          0.025,
          @steel
        )
      end
    end

    # Tay do tam console
    [-1, 1].each do |side|
      4.times do |i|
        x = side * (4.2 + i * 3.1)

        add_beam(
          e,
          p3(x, y1, z),
          p3(x + side * 0.65, y1 - 0.55, z - 0.35),
          0.06,
          @steel_dark
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. THANG LEO VA LONG BAO VE
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '07 - Safety Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = LADDER_X
    y = LADDER_Y
    z0 = LADDER_BOTTOM
    z1 = LADDER_TOP

    # Thanh doc
    [-0.20, 0.20].each do |dx|
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x + dx, y, z0),
        p3(x + dx, y, z1),
        0.04,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Bac thang
    z = z0

    while z <= z1
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x - 0.20, y, z),
        p3(x + 0.20, y, z),
        0.028,
        @steel_light
      )

      z += LADDER_STEP
    end

    if CREATE_LADDER_CAGE
      cage_y = y + 0.22
      cage_bottom = 3.0

      [-0.42, 0.42].each do |dx|
        add_beam(
          e,
          p3(x + dx, cage_y, cage_bottom),
          p3(x + dx, cage_y, z1),
          0.03,
          @steel_dark
        )
      end

      z = cage_bottom

      while z <= z1
        add_beam(
          e,
          p3(x - 0.42, cage_y, z),
          p3(x + 0.42, cage_y, z),
          0.025,
          @steel
        )

        z += 0.60
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. DEN CHIEU SANG TREN DINH BIEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '08 - Billboard Lighting')
    e = g.entities

    count = 5
    spacing = BOARD_WIDTH / (count - 1).to_f

    count.times do |i|
      x = -BOARD_WIDTH / 2.0 + i * spacing
      z = BOARD_BOTTOM + BOARD_HEIGHT + 0.15

      # Tay den dua ra phia truoc
      add_beam(
        e,
        p3(x, FRONT_Y + 0.04, z),
        p3(x, FRONT_Y - 0.55, z + 0.18),
        0.04,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Than den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.22,
        FRONT_Y - 0.78,
        z + 0.10,
        0.44,
        0.24,
        0.12,
        @lamp_body
      )

      # Mat den
      add_box(
        e,
        x - 0.18,
        FRONT_Y - 0.79,
        z + 0.075,
        0.36,
        0.20,
        0.025,
        @lamp_glass
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. CHU NOI TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_raised_text(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '09 - Optional Raised Lettering')
    e = g.entities

    lettering = e.add_group
    lettering.name = 'Raised Billboard Text'

    lettering.entities.add_3d_text(
      'OUTDOOR ADVERTISING',
      TextAlignCenter,
      'Arial',
      false,
      true,
      u(0.65),
      0.0,
      0.0,
      true,
      u(0.04)
    )

    lettering.entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

      entity.material = @text_mat
    end

    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN,
      X_AXIS,
      90.degrees
    )

    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      p3(0, FRONT_Y - 0.12, BOARD_BOTTOM + 2.4)
    )

    lettering.transform!(translation * rotation)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def setup_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      p3(0, -36, 16),
      p3(0, 0, 7.5),
      v3(0, 0, 1)
    )

    view.camera = camera
    view.perspective = true
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. TAO MO HINH TONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create Outdoor Billboard 3D', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - COMPLETE MODEL'
      )

      build_ground(root)
      build_foundations(root)
      build_columns(root)
      build_box_posts(root)
      build_truss(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_catwalk(root)
      build_ladder(root)
      build_lights(root) if CREATE_LIGHTS
      build_raised_text(root) if CREATE_RAISED_TEXT

      model.commit_operation
      setup_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD CREATED SUCCESSFULLY'
      puts "Pano: #{BOARD_WIDTH}m x #{BOARD_HEIGHT}m"
      puts "Cao do day pano: #{BOARD_BOTTOM}m"
      puts "So cot chinh: #{COLUMN_X.length}"
      puts 'Cac bo phan da duoc phan nhom rieng.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================

# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SignBoardMockup
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAU HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  BOARD_W = 8.4
  BOARD_H = 2.65
  BOARD_D = 0.32

  BOARD_X = 0.0
  BOARD_Y = -0.34
  BOARD_Z = 5.05

  WALL_W = 12.0
  WALL_H = 8.0
  WALL_D = 0.25

  LETTER_SIZE = 0.72
  LETTER_DEPTH = 0.035

  LIGHT_COUNT = 6
  LIGHT_SPACING = 1.32

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_DOOR = true
  CREATE_OPTIONAL_OUTDOOR_SUPPORTS = false
  CREATE_LOGO = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = material('SBM Dark Graphite Wall', [35, 46, 57])
    @wall_line = material('SBM Wall Seams', [62, 75, 86])

    @red = material('SBM Signboard Red', [205, 16, 28])
    @red_side = material('SBM Red Side Panels', [104, 9, 17])
    @red_detail = material('SBM Red Graphic Accent', [236, 35, 46])

    @white = material('SBM White Lettering', [255, 255, 252])
    @steel = material('SBM Dark Steel', [36, 44, 51])
    @aluminium = material('SBM Aluminium', [155, 166, 174])

    @lamp = material('SBM Lamp Housing', [24, 29, 33])
    @lamp_glow = material('SBM Lamp Glass', [255, 240, 190])

    @glass = material('SBM Glass', [80, 108, 122], 0.42)
    @frame = material('SBM Door Frame', [28, 38, 47])
    @concrete = material('SBM Concrete', [130, 132, 129])
    @logo = material('SBM Logo White', [255, 255, 255])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      pt(x, y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(dz))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, width, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    ux = direction.cross(ref)
    ux.normalize!
    uy = direction.cross(ux)
    uy.normalize!

    h = m(width) / 2.0

    corners = [
      a.offset(ux, h).offset(uy, h),
      a.offset(ux, -h).offset(uy, h),
      a.offset(ux, -h).offset(uy, -h),
      a.offset(ux, h).offset(uy, -h)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 24)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG MAT DUNG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Dark Graphite Facade')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -WALL_W / 2.0,
      0.12,
      0,
      WALL_W,
      WALL_D,
      WALL_H,
      @wall
    )

    # Duong ron ngang tuong
    15.times do |i|
      z = 0.35 + i * 0.48

      box(
        e,
        -WALL_W / 2.0,
        0.075,
        z,
        WALL_W,
        0.035,
        0.025,
        @wall_line
      )
    end

    # Duong ron dung ben trai
    box(
      e,
      -WALL_W / 2.0 + 0.28,
      0.065,
      0,
      0.045,
      0.035,
      WALL_H,
      @wall_line
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG BIEN HIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Signboard Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = BOARD_X - BOARD_W / 2.0
    x2 = BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2.0
    y = BOARD_Y + BOARD_D
    z1 = BOARD_Z
    z2 = BOARD_Z + BOARD_H

    # Khung chu nhat
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.07, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.07, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.07, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.07, @steel)

    # Thanh dung ben trong
    7.times do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 6.0

      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1 + 0.08),
        pt(x, y, z2 - 0.08),
        0.035,
        @aluminium
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang gia cuong
    [0.18, BOARD_H / 2.0, BOARD_H - 0.18].each do |dz|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1 + 0.06, y, z1 + dz),
        pt(x2 - 0.06, y, z1 + dz),
        0.035,
        @aluminium
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THAN BIEN HIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_body(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Red Signboard Housing')
    e = g.entities

    x = BOARD_X - BOARD_W / 2.0
    y = BOARD_Y
    z = BOARD_Z

    # Than hop bien do
    box(e, x, y, z, BOARD_W, BOARD_D, BOARD_H, @red)

    # Canh ben trai tao chieu sau
    box(
      e,
      x - 0.10,
      y + 0.015,
      z,
      0.12,
      BOARD_D + 0.04,
      BOARD_H,
      @red_side
    )

    # Vien tren va duoi
    box(
      e,
      x,
      y - 0.035,
      z + BOARD_H - 0.045,
      BOARD_W,
      0.045,
      0.045,
      @red_side
    )

    box(
      e,
      x,
      y - 0.035,
      z,
      BOARD_W,
      0.045,
      0.045,
      @red_side
    )

    # Duong cheo trang tri mat truoc
    front_y = y - 0.045

    beam(
      e,
      pt(BOARD_X + 2.15, front_y, z + BOARD_H - 0.08),
      pt(BOARD_X + 3.05, front_y, z + 0.08),
      0.10,
      @red_detail
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(BOARD_X + 2.50, front_y - 0.006, z + BOARD_H - 0.08),
      pt(BOARD_X + 3.40, front_y - 0.006, z + 0.08),
      0.045,
      @red_side
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_text(parent, text, height, x, y, z, mat, font = 'Arial')
    g = group(parent, "Raised Text - #{text}")

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignLeft,
        font,
        false,
        true,
        m(height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(LETTER_DEPTH)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Chu mac dinh tao tren mat phang XY.
      # Xoay de mat chu huong ra phia truoc (truc -Y).
      rotate = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      move = Geom::Transformation.translation(pt(x, y, z))
      g.transform!(move * rotate)
    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Khong tao duoc text '#{text}': #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_sign_text(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - Raised White Sign Typography')
    x = BOARD_X - BOARD_W / 2.0 + 0.65
    y = BOARD_Y - 0.07
    z = BOARD_Z + 1.43

    add_text(
      g,
      'Sign Board',
      0.78,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      @white,
      'Arial'
    )

    add_text(
      g,
      'Mockup',
      0.78,
      x,
      y,
      z - 0.86,
      @white,
      'Arial'
    )

    # Logo hinh hoc don gian ben phai
    if CREATE_LOGO
      build_logo(g)
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # LOGO TRANG TRI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_logo(parent)
    g = group(parent, 'White Geometric Logo')
    e = g.entities

    x = BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2.0 - 0.62
    y = BOARD_Y - 0.085
    z = BOARD_Z + 0.34

    # Hinh dang logo cach dieu tu cac thanh hop
    beam(
      e,
      pt(x - 0.20, y, z + 0.20),
      pt(x + 0.05, y, z + 0.43),
      0.11,
      @logo
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x + 0.05, y, z + 0.43),
      pt(x + 0.22, y, z + 0.24),
      0.11,
      @logo
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x + 0.22, y, z + 0.24),
      pt(x + 0.03, y, z + 0.03),
      0.11,
      @logo
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x + 0.03, y, z + 0.03),
      pt(x - 0.14, y, z + 0.16),
      0.11,
      @logo
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DEN CHIEU SANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lighting(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - Signboard Spotlights')
    e = g.entities

    count = LIGHT_COUNT
    first_x = BOARD_X - (count - 1) * LIGHT_SPACING / 2.0

    count.times do |i|
      x = first_x + i * LIGHT_SPACING
      z = BOARD_Z + BOARD_H + 0.28

      # Chan gan den vao tuong
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.015,
        z + 0.10,
        0.065,
        0.07,
        @steel,
        16
      )

      # Tay den huong ra phia truoc
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, 0.05, z + 0.10),
        pt(x, -0.42, z + 0.02),
        0.035,
        @lamp
      )

      # Than den
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.13,
        -0.50,
        z - 0.05,
        0.26,
        0.16,
        0.09,
        @lamp
      )

      # Mat phat sang
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.105,
        -0.515,
        z - 0.067,
        0.21,
        0.13,
        0.025,
        @lamp_glow
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CUA KINH PHIA DUOI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_door(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - Glass Entrance and Frames')
    e = g.entities

    door_x = -3.1
    door_z = 0.0
    door_w = 6.2
    door_h = 3.1
    y = -0.005

    # Khung bao ngoai
    box(
      e,
      door_x,
      y,
      door_z,
      door_w,
      0.10,
      0.12,
      @frame
    )

    box(
      e,
      door_x,
      y,
      door_z,
      0.12,
      0.10,
      door_h,
      @frame
    )

    box(
      e,
      door_x + door_w - 0.12,
      y,
      door_z,
      0.12,
      0.10,
      door_h,
      @frame
    )

    box(
      e,
      door_x,
      y,
      door_h - 0.12,
      door_w,
      0.10,
      0.12,
      @frame
    )

    # Hai canh cua kinh
    pane_w = (door_w - 0.28) / 2.0

    2.times do |i|
      px = door_x + 0.14 + i * (pane_w + 0.02)

      box(
        e,
        px,
        -0.015,
        door_z + 0.14,
        pane_w,
        0.025,
        door_h - 0.28,
        @glass
      )

      # Thanh dung giua moi canh
      box(
        e,
        px,
        -0.06,
        door_z + 0.14,
        0.035,
        0.04,
        door_h - 0.28,
        @frame
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG CHAN BIEN / GIA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_support_brackets(parent)
    g = group(parent, '07 - Signboard Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = BOARD_X - BOARD_W / 2.0 + 0.50
    x2 = BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2.0 - 0.50

    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      # Tay do tren
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, 0.15, BOARD_Z + 0.35),
        pt(x, -0.38, BOARD_Z + 0.15),
        0.08,
        @steel
      )

      # Tay do duoi
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, 0.15, BOARD_Z + 0.10),
        pt(x, -0.38, BOARD_Z + 0.15),
        0.08,
        @steel
      )

      # Ban ma gan tuong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.14,
        0.025,
        BOARD_Z - 0.05,
        0.28,
        0.10,
        0.60,
        @aluminium
      )

      # Bu long
      [BOARD_Z + 0.06, BOARD_Z + 0.42].each do |z|
        cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          -0.035,
          z,
          0.035,
          0.045,
          @steel,
          12
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK PHU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = group(parent, '08 - Maintenance Catwalk')
    e = g.entities

    width = BOARD_W + 0.35
    depth = 0.70
    x = BOARD_X - width / 2.0
    y = BOARD_Y + BOARD_D + 0.05
    z = BOARD_Z - 0.34

    # San thao tac
    box(
      e,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      width,
      depth,
      0.08,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y, y + depth].each do |dy|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, dy, z - 0.02),
        pt(x + width, dy, z - 0.02),
        0.07,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Dam ngang
    13.times do |i|
      px = x + width * i / 12.0

      beam(
        e,
        pt(px, y, z - 0.02),
        pt(px, y + depth, z - 0.02),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can phia ngoai
    rail_z = z + 0.95
    outer_y = y + depth

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, outer_y, rail_z),
      pt(x + width, outer_y, rail_z),
      0.04,
      @aluminium
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, outer_y, z + 0.47),
      pt(x + width, outer_y, z + 0.47),
      0.03,
      @steel
    )

    13.times do |i|
      px = x + width * i / 12.0

      beam(
        e,
        pt(px, outer_y, z + 0.05),
        pt(px, outer_y, rail_z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO PHIA SAU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = group(parent, '09 - Rear Access Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2.0 + 0.30
    y = BOARD_Y + BOARD_D + 0.35
    z0 = 0.30
    z1 = BOARD_Z + BOARD_H - 0.10

    [-0.18, 0.18].each do |dx|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x + dx, y, z0),
        pt(x + dx, y, z1),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    z = z0

    while z <= z1
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x - 0.18, y, z),
        pt(x + 0.18, y, z),
        0.025,
        @aluminium
      )

      z += 0.30
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG VA COT NGOAI TROI TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_optional_supports(parent)
    g = group(parent, '10 - Optional Outdoor Foundations and Columns')
    e = g.entities

    [-3.0, 3.0].each do |x|
      # Mong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.65,
        -0.75,
        -1.0,
        1.30,
        1.30,
        1.0,
        @concrete
      )

      # Co mong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.45,
        -0.45,
        0,
        0.90,
        0.90,
        0.30,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.38,
        -0.38,
        0.30,
        0.76,
        0.76,
        0.07,
        @steel
      )

      # Cot tron
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.0,
        0.37,
        0.28,
        BOARD_Z - 0.25,
        @aluminium,
        36
      )

      # Ban ma dau cot
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.40,
        -0.40,
        BOARD_Z - 0.10,
        0.80,
        0.80,
        0.12,

  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera

  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build

title: SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
description: Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu. - THANH PHAN: - 01. Tuong gach trang tri
ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Tuong gach trang tri
# 02. Ket cau gia do thep gan tuong
# 03. Than hop bien quang cao
# 04. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 05. Mat pano mau cam do
# 06. Vien nep kim loai sang mau
# 07. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Mockup"
# 08. Tam op hong va nep canh
# 09. Bu long va ban ma lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/signboard_mockup.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SignboardMockup
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WIDTH = 2.35
  HEIGHT = 0.88
  DEPTH = 0.22
  CENTER_Z = 3.25

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.035
  FACE_THICKNESS = 0.018
  BORDER_SIZE = 0.025

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING = true
  CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME = true
  CREATE_LETTERING = true
  CREATE_REAR_PLATE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = make_material('Wall - Grey Limestone', [151, 147, 136])
    @mortar = make_material('Wall - Mortar Joints', [90, 88, 82])
    @wall_shadow = make_material('Wall - Recessed Surface', [111, 108, 100])

    @cabinet = make_material('Sign - Dark Burgundy Cabinet', [53, 28, 35])
    @cabinet_side = make_material('Sign - Burgundy Side', [76, 34, 43])
    @frame = make_material('Sign - Dark Steel Frame', [43, 39, 40])

    @orange = make_material('Sign - Coral Orange Face', [246, 91, 54])
    @orange_dark = make_material('Sign - Inner Orange Border', [219, 65, 43])
    @white = make_material('Sign - Ivory White Trim', [245, 235, 213])
    @lettering = make_material('Sign - White Letters', [255, 249, 237])

    @steel = make_material('Mount - Galvanized Steel', [124, 125, 125])
    @steel_dark = make_material('Mount - Dark Steel', [55, 53, 54])
    @bolt = make_material('Mount - Metal Fasteners', [175, 171, 157])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON KIM LOAI VA BU LONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG GACH THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Architectural Brick Wall')
    e = g.entities

    wall_width = 4.0
    wall_height = 3.4
    wall_depth = 0.24
    wall_z = CENTER_Z - 1.7

    add_box(
      e,
      -wall_width / 2.0,
      0.12,
      wall_z,
      wall_width,
      wall_depth,
      wall_height,
      @wall
    )

    # Tao cac mach ngang tren mat tuong.
    z = wall_z + 0.08
    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(-wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        pt(wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        0.009,
        @mortar
      )
      z += 0.22
    end

    # Mach doc chia vien gach, so le theo tung hang.
    row = 0
    z = wall_z + 0.08

    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      offset = row.even? ? 0.0 : 0.18
      x = -wall_width / 2.0 + offset

      while x < wall_width / 2.0
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.105, z),
          pt(x, 0.105, z + 0.22),
          0.008,
          @mortar
        )
        x += 0.36
      end

      z += 0.22
      row += 1
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO HOP BIEN QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cabinet(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Sign Cabinet')
    e = g.entities

    x = -WIDTH / 2.0
    z = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0

    # Than hop chinh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x,
      -DEPTH,
      z,
      WIDTH,
      DEPTH,
      HEIGHT,
      @cabinet
    )

    # Nep hong ben trai tao chieu sau giong anh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x - 0.025,
      -DEPTH - 0.008,
      z - 0.025,
      0.075,
      DEPTH + 0.016,
      HEIGHT + 0.05,
      @cabinet_side
    )

    # Mat pano cam do.
    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.055,
      -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS,
      z + 0.055,
      WIDTH - 0.11,
      FACE_THICKNESS,
      HEIGHT - 0.11,
      @orange
    )

    # Vien kim loai sang bao quanh pano.
    front_y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS - 0.006

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + HEIGHT - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + WIDTH - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    # Nep do noi phia trong.
    inner = 0.075
    inner_border = 0.009

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + inner,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + HEIGHT - inner - inner_border,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG THEP BEN TRONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_internal_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Internal Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.055
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.055
    y = -DEPTH + 0.035
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.055
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.055

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)

    [-0.75, -0.25, 0.25, 0.75].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1),
        pt(x, y, z2),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    [0.20, 0.40, 0.60].each do |offset|
      z = z1 + offset
      next if z >= z2

      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z),
        pt(x2, y, z),
        0.015,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIA DO GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Wall Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    x_positions = [
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.10,
      WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.10
    ]

    z_positions = [
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.13,
      CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.13
    ]

    x_positions.each do |x|
      z_positions.each do |z|
        # Ban ma gan vao tuong.
        add_box(
          e,
          x - 0.06,
          0.035,
          z - 0.055,
          0.12,
          0.13,
          0.11,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Tay do vuong goc.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.12, z),
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          0.035,
          @steel
        )

        # Thanh noi vao mat sau bien.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          pt(x, -DEPTH + 0.02, z),
          0.035,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Bu long gan ban ma.
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          0.025,
          z,
          0.012,
          0.012,
          @bolt,
          16
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM OP SAU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_rear_plate(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Rear Service Panel')
    e = g.entities

    add_box(
      e,
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.06,
      DEPTH * 0.30,
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.06,
      WIDTH - 0.12,
      0.025,
      HEIGHT - 0.12,
      @cabinet_side
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_3d_text(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z,
                  text_height, thickness, mat,
                  font = 'Arial', bold = false)
    g = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        m(text_height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(thickness)
      )

      # Chu mac dinh nam tren XY, xoay dung de huong ra mat bien.
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(
          ORIGIN,
          X_AXIS,
          90.degrees
        )
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      bounds = g.bounds

      target_x = m(center_x)
      target_y = -m(DEPTH + FACE_THICKNESS + 0.018)
      target_z = m(center_z)

      translation = Geom::Vector3d.new(
        target_x - (bounds.min.x + bounds.max.x) / 2.0,
        target_y - bounds.min.y,
        target_z - (bounds.min.z + bounds.max.z) / 2.0
      )

      g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(translation))

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text creation failed [#{text}]: #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOI DUNG MAT PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lettering(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - Raised White Typography')

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      'SignBoard Mockup Text',
      'SignBoard Mockup',
      0.0,
      CENTER_Z + 0.015,
      0.155,
      0.009,
      @lettering,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH GIA CUONG VA NEP VIEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_edge_details(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Edge Reinforcement')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.025
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.025
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.025
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.025
    y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS - 0.009

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.008, @white)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(2.6, -4.6, CENTER_Z + 1.0)
    target = pt(0, 0, CENTER_Z)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      eye,
      target,
      vec(0, 0, 1)
    )

    camera.perspective = true
    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO TOAN BO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create SignBoard Mockup', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'SignBoard Mockup - Complete Assembly'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL
      build_cabinet(root)
      build_internal_frame(root) if CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME
      build_mounting(root) if CREATE_MOUNTING
      build_rear_plate(root) if CREATE_REAR_PLATE
      build_edge_details(root)
      build_lettering(root) if CREATE_LETTERING

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'SIGNBOARD MOCKUP CREATED'
      puts "Width:  #{WIDTH} m"
      puts "Height: #{HEIGHT} m"
      puts "Depth:  #{DEPTH} m"
      puts 'Wall, cabinet, steel frame, wall brackets,'
      puts 'coral panel, white trim and 3D lettering created.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "SIGNBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

require 'sketchup.rb'

module AhimsaSignage
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_W = 1.50
  SIGN_H = 1.15
  SIGN_T = 0.055
  CORNER_R = 0.075

  SIGN_X = 0.0
  SIGN_Y = 0.0
  SIGN_Z = 2.00

  WALL_W = 3.2
  WALL_H = 3.8
  WALL_D = 0.22

  LETTER_DEPTH = 0.018
  LETTER_H = 0.245
  SUBTITLE_H = 0.095

  SCREW_R = 0.014
  SCREW_OFFSET_X = 0.075
  SCREW_OFFSET_Z = 0.075

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_OUTDOOR_SUPPORTS = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @black = material('AHIMSA Matte Black Acrylic', [24, 25, 23])
    @black_edge = material('AHIMSA Black Acrylic Edge', [10, 11, 10])
    @gold = material('AHIMSA Brushed Champagne Gold', [207, 174, 91])
    @gold_light = material('AHIMSA Gold Highlight', [241, 220, 153])
    @gold_dark = material('AHIMSA Gold Side', [112, 83, 34])

    @steel = material('AHIMSA Stainless Steel', [184, 190, 188])
    @steel_dark = material('AHIMSA Screw Shadow', [70, 72, 70])

    @wall = material('AHIMSA Warm Beige Stone', [215, 207, 188])
    @wall_line = material('AHIMSA Stone Joints', [190, 180, 161])

    @concrete = material('AHIMSA Concrete', [153, 153, 145])
    @structural_steel = material('AHIMSA Structural Steel', [75, 84, 88])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      pt(x, y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(dz))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM PHANG DUNG BO GOC
  # Mat bien nam tren mat phang XZ, huong nhin ra truc Y am.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def rounded_rectangle(entities, x, y, z, width, height, radius, mat, segments = 8)
    r = [radius, width / 2.0, height / 2.0].min
    corners = [
      [x + width - r, z + height - r, 0.0],
      [x + r, z + height - r, 90.0],
      [x + r, z + r, 180.0],
      [x + width - r, z + r, 270.0]
    ]

    points = []

    corners.each do |cx, cz, start_angle|
      segments.times do |i|
        angle = (start_angle + i * 90.0 / (segments - 1)) * Math::PI / 180.0
        points << pt(
          cx + r * Math.cos(angle),
          y,
          cz + r * Math.sin(angle)
        )
      end
    end

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face
  end

  def make_vertical_panel(parent, name, x, y, z, width, height, thickness, radius, mat)
    g = group(parent, name)
    e = g.entities

    face = rounded_rectangle(
      e, x, y, z, width, height, radius, mat
    )

    if face && face.valid?
      # Tao do day theo truc Y, mat truoc huong ve Y am.
      face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0
      face.pushpull(m(thickness))
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, width, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    ux = direction.cross(ref)
    ux.normalize!
    uy = direction.cross(ux)
    uy.normalize!

    h = m(width) / 2.0

    corners = [
      a.offset(ux, h).offset(uy, h),
      a.offset(ux, -h).offset(uy, h),
      a.offset(ux, -h).offset(uy, -h),
      a.offset(ux, h).offset(uy, -h)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 24)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG TRANG TRI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Beige Stone Wall')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -WALL_W / 2.0,
      0.10,
      0.0,
      WALL_W,
      WALL_D,
      WALL_H,
      @wall
    )

    # Duong ron da ngang nhe
    [0.55, 1.20, 1.85, 2.50, 3.15].each do |z|
      box(
        e,
        -WALL_W / 2.0,
        0.075,
        z,
        WALL_W,
        0.035,
        0.008,
        @wall_line
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM BIEN DEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_panel(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Rounded Matte Black Sign')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0
    z = SIGN_Z
    y = SIGN_Y

    # Lop dem sau, nho hon tam bien chinh
    make_vertical_panel(
      g,
      'Rear Shadow Spacer',
      x + 0.012,
      y + 0.025,
      z + 0.012,
      SIGN_W - 0.024,
      SIGN_H - 0.024,
      0.035,
      CORNER_R * 0.85,
      @black_edge
    )

    # Tam acrylic den
    make_vertical_panel(
      g,
      'Front Matte Black Acrylic',
      x,
      y - 0.015,
      z,
      SIGN_W,
      SIGN_H,
      SIGN_T,
      CORNER_R,
      @black
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # BU LONG / NUT STANDOFF
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting_bolts(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Four Stainless Stand-off Bolts')
    e = g.entities

    x_left = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0 + SCREW_OFFSET_X
    x_right = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 - SCREW_OFFSET_X

    z_bottom = SIGN_Z + SCREW_OFFSET_Z
    z_top = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - SCREW_OFFSET_Z

    [[x_left, z_bottom], [x_left, z_top],
     [x_right, z_bottom], [x_right, z_top]].each do |x, z|

      # Than spacer gan tuong, truc truong song song Y
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        SIGN_Y - 0.005,
        z,
        0.022,
        0.035,
        @steel_dark,
        20
      )

      # Dau nut kim loai tren mat bien
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        SIGN_Y - 0.065,
        z,
        0.018,
        0.055,
        @steel,
        24
      )

      # Mat nut sang hon
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        SIGN_Y - 0.070,
        z,
        0.012,
        0.008,
        @gold_light,
        24
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def create_3d_text(parent, label, size, x, y, z, mat, font = 'Arial')
    g = group(parent, "Raised Letter - #{label}")

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        label,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        false,
        true,
        m(size),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(LETTER_DEPTH)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Xoay chu de mat chu dung theo mat bien.
      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(pt(x, y, z))
      g.transform!(translation * rotation)

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text error '#{label}': #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_main_text(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - AHIMSA Raised Gold Typography')

    # Vi tri chu can giua tren tam bien
    create_3d_text(
      g,
      'AHIMSA',
      LETTER_H,
      SIGN_X,
      SIGN_Y - 0.105,
      SIGN_Z + 0.37,
      @gold,
      'Arial'
    )

    create_3d_text(
      g,
      'DENTAL SPA',
      SUBTITLE_H,
      SIGN_X,
      SIGN_Y - 0.105,
      SIGN_Z + 0.16,
      @gold_light,
      'Arial'
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # LOGO HOA SEN CACH DIEU
  # Dung cac canh cong va thanh dang la de tao hinh logo don gian.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lotus_logo(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - Champagne Gold Lotus Logo')
    e = g.entities

    cx = SIGN_X
    y = SIGN_Y - 0.11
    base_z = SIGN_Z + 0.73

    # Than la trung tam
    beam(
      e,
      pt(cx, y, base_z),
      pt(cx, y, base_z + 0.30),
      0.040,
      @gold
    )

    # Canh hoa sen trai va phai
    petals = [
      [-0.25, 0.02, -0.20, 0.24],
      [-0.20, 0.02, -0.12, 0.42],
      [-0.12, 0.02, -0.06, 0.53],
      [-0.06, 0.02,  0.00, 0.59],
      [ 0.00, 0.02,  0.06, 0.53],
      [ 0.06, 0.02,  0.12, 0.42],
      [ 0.12, 0.02,  0.20, 0.24],
      [ 0.20, 0.02,  0.25, 0.02]
    ]

    petals.each do |dx1, dz1, dx2, dz2|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(cx + dx1, y, base_z + dz1),
        pt(cx + dx2, y, base_z + dz2),
        0.045,
        @gold
      )
    end

    # La hoa hai ben
    beam(
      e,
      pt(cx - 0.27, y, base_z + 0.04),
      pt(cx - 0.33, y, base_z + 0.18),
      0.035,
      @gold_light
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(cx + 0.27, y, base_z + 0.04),
      pt(cx + 0.33, y, base_z + 0.18),
      0.035,
      @gold_light
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG GAN TUONG VA THANH THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_rear_mounting_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - Rear Mounting Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.12
    x2 = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.12
    z1 = SIGN_Z + 0.12
    z2 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.12
    y = SIGN_Y + SIGN_T + 0.02

    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.025, @structural_steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @structural_steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.025, @structural_steel)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @structural_steel)

    # Hai thanh gia cuong dung
    [-0.35, 0.35].each do |dx|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(SIGN_X + dx, y, z1),
        pt(SIGN_X + dx, y, z2),
        0.020,
        @structural_steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG, MONG, COT NGOAI TROI TUY CHON
  # Mac dinh tat vi anh tham chieu la bien gan tuong.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_optional_outdoor_structure(parent)
    g = group(parent, '07 - Optional Outdoor Sign Structure')
    e = g.entities

    [-0.45, 0.45].each do |x|
      # Mong be tong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.35,
        -0.45,
        -0.85,
        0.70,
        0.70,
        0.85,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de cot
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.22,
        -0.22,
        0.0,
        0.44,
        0.44,
        0.06,
        @steel
      )

      # Cot thep hop
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.09,
        -0.09,
        0.06,
        0.18,
        0.18,
        SIGN_Z - 0.10,
        @structural_steel
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.14, 0.14].each do |dx|
        [-0.14, 0.14].each do |dy|
          cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            dy,
            0.06,
            0.012,
            0.14,
            @steel,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Dam ngang lien ket hai cot
    beam(
      e,
      pt(-0.45, 0.0, SIGN_Z - 0.10),
      pt(0.45, 0.0, SIGN_Z - 0.10),
      0.08,
      @structural_steel
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(2.3, -4.2, 3.15)
    target = pt(0.0, 0.0, SIGN_Z + SIGN_H / 2.0)
    up = vec(0, 0, 1)

    view.camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, up)
    view.camera.perspective = true
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create AHIMSA Dental Spa Sign', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = group(
        model.active_entities,
        'AHIMSA DENTAL SPA - COMPLETE SIGNAGE'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL
      build_sign_panel(root)
      build_rear_mounting_frame(root)
      build_mounting_bolts(root)
      build_lotus_logo(root)
      build_main_text(root)

      if CREATE_OUTDOOR_SUPPORTS
        build_optional_outdoor_structure(root)
      end

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'AHIMSA DENTAL SPA SIGNAGE CREATED'
      puts "Kich thuoc tam bien: #{SIGN_W} x #{SIGN_H} m"
      puts "Do day tam bien: #{SIGN_T} m"
      puts 'Thanh phan: tam den, chu noi vang, logo hoa sen,'
      puts 'bon nut stand-off va khung gan tuong.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "AHIMSA SIGNAGE ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end
