# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# 3D SIGNAGE - ILLUMINATED FACADE SIGN
# SketchUp Ruby (.rb)
#
# Mo hinh bien hieu chu noi phat sang theo anh tham chieu:
# - Tuong mat tien va khoi nen
# - Tam bien hop kim / alu mau den
# - Khung xuong thep hop
# - Chu noi 3D SIGNAGE
# - Lop mat chu acrylic trang xanh
# - Vien chu va lop dem tao hieu ung chieu sau
# - Den LED, vo den, thanh gan tuong
# - Gia do, ban ma, bulong
# - Mong be tong, cot thep, catwalk va thang leo tuy chon
#
# Don vi: met
# Mat dung: XZ
# Mat truoc bien huong ve truc Y am
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/illuminated_signage.rb'
#
# Luu y: Mo hinh concept, khong thay the ho so ket cau.
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module IlluminatedSignage
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO CHINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_W = 5.20
  SIGN_H = 1.18
  SIGN_D = 0.32
  SIGN_X = 0.0
  SIGN_Y = 0.0
  SIGN_Z = 4.20

  WALL_W = 8.00
  WALL_H = 5.60
  WALL_D = 0.35

  LETTER_TEXT = '3D SIGNAGE'
  LETTER_SIZE = 0.88
  LETTER_DEPTH = 0.12
  LETTER_GAP = 0.08

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_SIGN_FRAME = true
  CREATE_LED_HOUSING = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING_HARDWARE = true
  CREATE_OUTDOOR_SUPPORTS = false
  CREATE_CATWALK = false
  CREATE_LADDER = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def mat(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    material = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    material.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    material.alpha = alpha
    material
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = mat('Signage - Charcoal Facade', [25, 27, 30])
    @wall_inner = mat('Signage - Recessed Dark Wall', [12, 14, 17])

    @body = mat('Signage - Black Aluminium Composite', [18, 21, 25])
    @body_side = mat('Signage - Black Metal Edge', [5, 7, 10])

    @steel = mat('Signage - Galvanized Steel', [100, 112, 124])
    @steel_light = mat('Signage - Brushed Aluminium', [177, 190, 202])
    @steel_dark = mat('Signage - Dark Steel', [39, 48, 58])

    @white = mat('Signage - LED White Acrylic', [215, 245, 255])
    @cyan = mat('Signage - Ice Blue LED', [65, 190, 255])
    @blue_glow = mat('Signage - Blue Glow', [38, 118, 255], 0.30)
    @led_core = mat('Signage - LED Core', [240, 252, 255])

    @concrete = mat('Signage - Concrete Foundation', [132, 134, 132])
    @glass = mat('Signage - Shop Glass', [38, 53, 62], 0.35)
    @rubber = mat('Signage - Cable Rubber', [12, 14, 17])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    return nil if dx <= 0 || dy <= 0 || dz <= 0

    corners = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y, z),
      pt(x + dx, y + dy, z),
      pt(x, y + dy, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(dz))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, width, material)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!
    reference = vec(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    u = direction.cross(reference)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(width) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, material, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAT TUONG MAT TIEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Shopfront Facade')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -WALL_W / 2.0,
      0.15,
      0.0,
      WALL_W,
      WALL_D,
      WALL_H,
      @wall
    )

    # Khoi cua hang ben duoi
    box(e, -WALL_W / 2.0, -0.01, 0.0, WALL_W, 0.18, 2.90, @wall_inner)

    # Khung cua kinh
    frame_y = -0.045
    door_z = 0.0
    door_h = 2.55

    [-2.65, -0.90, 0.90, 2.65].each do |x|
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.035,
        frame_y,
        door_z,
        0.07,
        0.07,
        door_h,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    box(
      e,
      -2.70,
      frame_y,
      door_h,
      5.40,
      0.08,
      0.08,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Mat kinh
    box(
      e,
      -2.55,
      -0.005,
      0.12,
      1.55,
      0.025,
      2.35,
      @glass
    )

    box(
      e,
      -0.80,
      -0.005,
      0.12,
      1.60,
      0.025,
      2.35,
      @glass
    )

    box(
      e,
      1.00,
      -0.005,
      0.12,
      1.55,
      0.025,
      2.35,
      @glass
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO BIEN HIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_body(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Main Sign Box')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0
    y = SIGN_Y - SIGN_D
    z = SIGN_Z

    # Vo hop chinh
    box(
      e,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      SIGN_W,
      SIGN_D,
      SIGN_H,
      @body
    )

    # Lop mat den truoc
    box(
      e,
      x + 0.045,
      y - 0.018,
      z + 0.045,
      SIGN_W - 0.09,
      0.025,
      SIGN_H - 0.09,
      @body
    )

    # Vien nhom bao quanh
    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, y - 0.035, z),
      pt(x + SIGN_W, y - 0.035, z),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, y - 0.035, z + SIGN_H),
      pt(x + SIGN_W, y - 0.035, z + SIGN_H),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, y - 0.035, z),
      pt(x, y - 0.035, z + SIGN_H),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x + SIGN_W, y - 0.035, z),
      pt(x + SIGN_W, y - 0.035, z + SIGN_H),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Sign Structural Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.10
    x2 = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.10
    y = SIGN_Y - 0.03
    z1 = SIGN_Z + 0.10
    z2 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.10

    # Khung chu nhat
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.055, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.055, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.055, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.055, @steel)

    # Thanh dung gia cuong
    1.upto(5) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 6.0
      beam(e, pt(x, y, z1), pt(x, y, z2), 0.035, @steel_dark)
    end

    # Thanh ngang ben trong
    z_mid = (z1 + z2) / 2.0
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z_mid), pt(x2, y, z_mid), 0.035, @steel_dark)

    # Thanh cheo gia cuong
    0.upto(5) do |i|
      xa = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 6.0
      xb = x1 + (x2 - x1) * (i + 1) / 6.0

      beam(
        e,
        pt(xa, y, z1),
        pt(xb, y, z2),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )

      beam(
        e,
        pt(xa, y, z2),
        pt(xb, y, z1),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D PHAT SANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def create_text_group(parent, text, size, material)
    g = group(parent, "Illuminated Text - #{text}")

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignCenter,
        'Arial',
        false,
        true,
        m(size),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(LETTER_DEPTH)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = material
        entity.back_material = material if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Xoay chu tu mat phang XY sang mat dung XZ
      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      # Dat mat chu ra truoc bien
      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        pt(SIGN_X, SIGN_Y - SIGN_D - 0.075, SIGN_Z + 0.18)
      )

      g.transform!(translation * rotation)

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Khong tao duoc chu '#{text}': #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_sign_text(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - 3D SIGNAGE Illuminated Letters')

    # Lop chu phat sang mau xanh nhat
    create_text_group(
      g,
      LETTER_TEXT,
      LETTER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    # Thanh LED trang tri phia sau chu
    e = g.entities
    x1 = SIGN_X - SIGN_W * 0.40
    x2 = SIGN_X + SIGN_W * 0.40
    z = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H * 0.20
    y = SIGN_Y - SIGN_D - 0.095

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x1, y, z),
      pt(x2, y, z),
      0.012,
      @cyan
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO DEN LED VA HIEU UNG VIEN SANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_led_housing(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - LED Backlight and Glow')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.12
    x2 = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.12
    z1 = SIGN_Z + 0.12
    z2 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.12
    y = SIGN_Y - SIGN_D - 0.05

    # Thanh LED sau chu
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.025, @cyan)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @cyan)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.025, @cyan)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @cyan)

    # Cum LED nho phia sau bien
    0.upto(9) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 9.0
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        SIGN_Y - 0.02,
        SIGN_Z + SIGN_H + 0.015,
        0.012,
        0.02,
        @led_core,
        12
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIA DO VA BU LONG GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting_hardware(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - Wall Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    x_positions = [
      SIGN_X - SIGN_W * 0.38,
      SIGN_X - SIGN_W * 0.13,
      SIGN_X + SIGN_W * 0.13,
      SIGN_X + SIGN_W * 0.38
    ]

    x_positions.each do |x|
      # Ban ma sat gan tuong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.10,
        SIGN_Y + 0.01,
        SIGN_Z + 0.18,
        0.20,
        0.08,
        0.25,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Tay console
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, SIGN_Y + 0.04, SIGN_Z + 0.20),
        pt(x, SIGN_Y - SIGN_D + 0.02, SIGN_Z + 0.20),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )

      # Bu long
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        SIGN_Y + 0.10,
        SIGN_Z + 0.24,
        0.018,
        0.025,
        @steel_light,
        16
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG BE TONG VA COT THEP NGOAI TROI TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_outdoor_supports(parent)
    g = group(parent, '07 - Outdoor Columns and Foundations')
    e = g.entities

    [-1.60, 1.60].each do |x|
      # Mong be tong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.45,
        -0.50,
        -1.20,
        0.90,
        1.00,
        1.20,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.24,
        -0.24,
        0.0,
        0.48,
        0.48,
        0.08,
        @steel
      )

      # Cot thep tron
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.0,
        0.08,
        0.15,
        SIGN_Z - 0.15,
        @steel,
        32
      )

      # Dai cot
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.0,
        SIGN_Z - 0.20,
        0.18,
        0.12,
        @steel_dark,
        32
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.15, 0.15].each do |dx|
        [-0.15, 0.15].each do |dy|
          cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            dy,
            0.08,
            0.012,
            0.16,
            @steel_light,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Dam ngang lien ket cot
    beam(
      e,
      pt(-1.60, 0.0, SIGN_Z - 0.12),
      pt(1.60, 0.0, SIGN_Z - 0.12),
      0.12,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = group(parent, '08 - Maintenance Catwalk')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = SIGN_X - SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.20
    x2 = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.20
    y1 = SIGN_Y + 0.10
    y2 = SIGN_Y + 0.85
    z = SIGN_Z - 0.18

    box(
      e,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      x2 - x1,
      y2 - y1,
      0.07,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    beam(e, pt(x1, y1, z), pt(x2, y1, z), 0.06, @steel)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y2, z), pt(x2, y2, z), 0.06, @steel)

    # Thanh ngang san
    0.upto(12) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 12.0
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y1, z + 0.04),
        pt(x, y2, z + 0.04),
        0.018,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = group(parent, '09 - Fixed Access Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 + 0.25
    y = SIGN_Y + 0.20
    z0 = 0.10
    z1 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.10

    # Hai thanh dung
    beam(e, pt(x, y, z0), pt(x, y, z1), 0.045, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x + 0.35, y, z0), pt(x + 0.35, y, z1), 0.045, @steel_dark)

    # Bac thang
    steps = ((z1 - z0) / 0.28).to_i
    0.upto(steps) do |i|
      z = z0 + i * 0.28
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z),
        pt(x + 0.35, y, z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DAY DIEN VA ONG LUON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cable_conduit(parent)
    g = group(parent, '10 - Electrical Conduit')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_X + SIGN_W / 2.0 - 0.12
    y = SIGN_Y + 0.08
    z1 = SIGN_Z - 0.20
    z2 = SIGN_Z + SIGN_H + 0.10

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x, y, z1),
      pt(x, y, z2),
      0.025,
      @rubber
    )

    # Hop dau noi dien
    box(
      e,
      x - 0.06,
      y - 0.04,
      SIGN_Z + SIGN_H - 0.10,
      0.12,
      0.08,
      0.12,
      @steel_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(2.8, -7.0, 6.2)
    target = pt(0.0, 0.0, SIGN_Z + SIGN_H / 2.0)
    up = vec(0, 0, 1)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, up)
    camera.perspective = true
    view.camera = camera

    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAIN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create Illuminated 3D Signage', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = group(
        model.active_entities,
        '3D SIGNAGE - Illuminated Facade Sign'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL
      build_sign_body(root)
      build_sign_frame(root) if CREATE_SIGN_FRAME
      build_sign_text(root)

      build_led_housing(root) if CREATE_LED_HOUSING
      build_mounting_hardware(root) if CREATE_MOUNTING_HARDWARE
      build_outdoor_supports(root) if CREATE_OUTDOOR_SUPPORTS
      build_catwalk(root) if CREATE_CATWALK
      build_ladder(root) if CREATE_LADDER
      build_cable_conduit(root) if CREATE_LED_HOUSING

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts '3D SIGNAGE MODEL CREATED'
      puts "Sign: #{SIGN_W} x #{SIGN_H} x #{SIGN_D} m"
      puts "Text: #{LETTER_TEXT}"
      puts 'LED blue-white lighting and steel frame included.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "SIGNAGE MODEL ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# 3D WALL SIGNAGE - XBIGSWITCH NETWORKS
# SketchUp Ruby Script (.rb)
#
# Mo hinh bien hieu chu noi 3D theo anh tham chieu:
# - Tuong nen mau trang kem
# - Tam bien/backplate an sau chu
# - Chu noi "xbigSwitch" mau den than
# - Bieu tuong X mau xanh cyan
# - Chu "networks" mau xanh duong
# - Logo trang tri phia duoi
# - Chan dem, pat gan tuong, bu long
# - Khung xuong thep va he gia do
# - Tuy chon mong be tong, cot thep, catwalk va thang leo
#
# Don vi: met
# Mat tuong: XZ
# Mat truoc huong ve Y am
#
# Luu file .rb, sau do chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/xbigswitch_signage.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module XBigSwitchSignage
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WALL_WIDTH  = 8.0
  WALL_HEIGHT = 5.0
  WALL_DEPTH  = 0.25

  SIGN_WIDTH  = 4.30
  SIGN_HEIGHT = 1.85
  SIGN_DEPTH  = 0.12

  SIGN_CENTER_X = 0.0
  SIGN_FRONT_Y  = -0.10
  SIGN_BOTTOM_Z = 2.15

  MAIN_TEXT = 'xbigSwitch'
  SUB_TEXT  = 'networks'

  MAIN_TEXT_SIZE = 0.76
  SUB_TEXT_SIZE  = 0.62
  TEXT_DEPTH     = 0.075

  CREATE_WALL             = true
  CREATE_BACKPLATE        = false
  CREATE_MOUNTING_BRACKETS = true
  CREATE_OUTDOOR_FOUNDATION = false
  CREATE_CATWALK           = false
  CREATE_LADDER            = false

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA HINH HOC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def point(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vector(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    group = parent.add_group
    group.name = name
    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall_mat = material(
      'XBS - Warm White Wall',
      [232, 230, 220]
    )

    @backplate_mat = material(
      'XBS - Hidden Dark Backplate',
      [32, 34, 38]
    )

    @black_mat = material(
      'XBS - Graphite Raised Letters',
      [35, 35, 38]
    )

    @black_side_mat = material(
      'XBS - Letter Side Graphite',
      [16, 18, 21]
    )

    @cyan_mat = material(
      'XBS - Cyan Blue Logo',
      [30, 158, 211]
    )

    @blue_mat = material(
      'XBS - Network Blue',
      [32, 137, 192]
    )

    @logo_gray_mat = material(
      'XBS - Secondary Logo Gray',
      [158, 158, 153]
    )

    @steel_mat = material(
      'XBS - Galvanized Steel',
      [125, 133, 139]
    )

    @steel_dark_mat = material(
      'XBS - Dark Steel',
      [56, 62, 67]
    )

    @concrete_mat = material(
      'XBS - Concrete',
      [143, 142, 135]
    )

    @bolt_mat = material(
      'XBS - Stainless Steel',
      [190, 194, 197]
    )
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    corners = [
      point(x, y, z),
      point(x + width, y, z),
      point(x + width, y + depth, z),
      point(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, p1, p2, width, mat)
    direction = p2 - p1
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = vector(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vector(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    u = direction.cross(reference)
    u.normalize!

    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(width) / 2.0

    corners = [
      p1.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      p1.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      p1.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      p1.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      point(x, y, z),
      vector(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG NEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '01 - Architectural Wall')
    entities = group.entities

    add_box(
      entities,
      -WALL_WIDTH / 2.0,
      0.20,
      0.0,
      WALL_WIDTH,
      WALL_DEPTH,
      WALL_HEIGHT,
      @wall_mat
    )

    # Phan tuong trang sau bien hieu
    add_box(
      entities,
      -WALL_WIDTH / 2.0,
      0.10,
      0.0,
      WALL_WIDTH,
      0.12,
      0.08,
      @wall_mat
    )

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM BACKPLATE AN SAU CHU (TUY CHON)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_backplate(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '02 - Concealed Sign Backplate')
    entities = group.entities

    x = SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    y = SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.035
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM_Z

    add_box(
      entities,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      SIGN_WIDTH,
      SIGN_DEPTH,
      SIGN_HEIGHT,
      @backplate_mat
    )

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_3d_text(parent, text, size, depth, mat, name)
    group = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      group.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        false,
        true,
        m(size),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(depth)
      )

      group.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Chu mac dinh tao tren XY.
      # Xoay 90 do quanh X de dung chu tren mat phang XZ.
      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      # Sau khi xoay, truc Y cua chu tro thanh truc Z am.
      # Dung dich chuyen de dua chu ra truoc mat tuong.
      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        point(0.0, SIGN_FRONT_Y, 0.0)
      )

      group.transform!(translation * rotation)

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Loi tao chu #{text}: #{error.message}"
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DAT CHU THEO VI TRI TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def place_text_group(group, x, y, z)
    bounds = group.bounds

    current_min_x = bounds.min.x
    current_min_z = bounds.min.z

    target_x = m(x)
    target_y = m(y)
    target_z = m(z)

    transform = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(
        target_x - current_min_x,
        target_y - bounds.min.y,
        target_z - current_min_z
      )
    )

    group.transform!(transform)
    group
  end

  def build_main_text(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '03 - Main Raised Text')
    entities = group.entities

    text_group = entities.add_group

    begin
      text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
        MAIN_TEXT,
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        false,
        true,
        m(MAIN_TEXT_SIZE),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(TEXT_DEPTH)
      )

      text_group.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = @black_mat
        entity.back_material = @black_mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Dung chu tren mat dung
      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      text_group.transform!(rotation)

      # Dat chu o nua tren cua bien
      bounds = text_group.bounds
      desired_x = m(SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.43)
      desired_y = m(SIGN_FRONT_Y - 0.10)
      desired_z = m(SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.46)

      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          desired_x - bounds.min.x,
          desired_y - bounds.min.y,
          desired_z - bounds.min.z
        )
      )

      text_group.transform!(translation)
      text_group.name = 'xbigSwitch - Graphite Raised Letters'

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Loi tao chu chinh: #{error.message}"
    end

    group
  end

  def build_sub_text(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '04 - Networks Raised Text')
    entities = group.entities

    text_group = entities.add_group

    begin
      text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
        SUB_TEXT,
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        false,
        true,
        m(SUB_TEXT_SIZE),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(TEXT_DEPTH * 0.80)
      )

      text_group.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = @blue_mat
        entity.back_material = @blue_mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      text_group.transform!(rotation)

      bounds = text_group.bounds

      desired_x = m(SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.18)
      desired_y = m(SIGN_FRONT_Y - 0.12)
      desired_z = m(SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.13)

      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          desired_x - bounds.min.x,
          desired_y - bounds.min.y,
          desired_z - bounds.min.z
        )
      )

      text_group.transform!(translation)
      text_group.name = 'networks - Blue Raised Letters'

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Loi tao chu phu: #{error.message}"
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # BIEU TUONG X MAU CYAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_x_logo(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '05 - Cyan X Logo')
    entities = group.entities

    center_x = SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.38
    center_z = SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.42
    front_y = SIGN_FRONT_Y - 0.13

    # Hai thanh cheo tao hinh X
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(center_x - 0.13, front_y, center_z + 0.26),
      point(center_x + 0.13, front_y, center_z - 0.26),
      0.12,
      @cyan_mat
    )

    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(center_x - 0.13, front_y - 0.015, center_z - 0.26),
      point(center_x + 0.13, front_y - 0.015, center_z + 0.26),
      0.12,
      @cyan_mat
    )

    # Thanh vien trang tri nho
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(center_x - 0.19, front_y - 0.02, center_z + 0.08),
      point(center_x - 0.10, front_y - 0.02, center_z + 0.17),
      0.035,
      @blue_mat
    )

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # LOGO PHU PHIA DUOI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_secondary_logo(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '06 - Secondary Brand Mark')
    entities = group.entities

    x = SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.16
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.35
    y = SIGN_FRONT_Y - 0.06

    # Bieu tuong dang la cach dieu
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x, y, z),
      point(x + 0.10, y, z + 0.14),
      0.018,
      @logo_gray_mat
    )

    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x + 0.10, y, z + 0.14),
      point(x + 0.20, y, z + 0.02),
      0.018,
      @logo_gray_mat
    )

    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x + 0.04, y - 0.01, z + 0.03),
      point(x + 0.16, y - 0.01, z + 0.03),
      0.018,
      @logo_gray_mat
    )

    # Ten thuong hieu phu
    begin
      logo_text = entities.add_group

      logo_text.entities.add_3d_text(
        'ZAHRAT ALMADINA',
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        false,
        false,
        m(0.17),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(0.006)
      )

      logo_text.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = @logo_gray_mat
      end

      rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      logo_text.transform!(rotation)

      bounds = logo_text.bounds
      translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          m(x + 0.25) - bounds.min.x,
          m(y) - bounds.min.y,
          m(z - 0.03) - bounds.min.z
        )
      )

      logo_text.transform!(translation)

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Khong tao duoc logo phu: #{error.message}"
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHAN DEM VA PAT GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting_brackets(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '07 - Concealed Wall Mounts')
    entities = group.entities

    x_positions = [
      SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.38,
      SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH * 0.13,
      SIGN_CENTER_X + SIGN_WIDTH * 0.13,
      SIGN_CENTER_X + SIGN_WIDTH * 0.38
    ]

    x_positions.each do |x|
      # Pat gan tuong
      add_box(
        entities,
        x - 0.06,
        SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.04,
        SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + 0.45,
        0.12,
        0.08,
        0.18,
        @steel_dark_mat
      )

      # Tay do
      add_beam(
        entities,
        point(x, SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.06, SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + 0.52),
        point(x, SIGN_FRONT_Y - SIGN_DEPTH, SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + 0.52),
        0.035,
        @steel_mat
      )

      # Bu long gan tuong
      add_cylinder(
        entities,
        x,
        SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.13,
        SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + 0.49,
        0.014,
        0.025,
        @bolt_mat,
        12
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG BE TONG VA COT THEP TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_outdoor_foundation(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '08 - Outdoor Foundations and Columns')
    entities = group.entities

    [-1.40, 1.40].each do |x|
      # Mong be tong
      add_box(
        entities,
        x - 0.35,
        -0.45,
        -1.00,
        0.70,
        0.90,
        1.00,
        @concrete_mat
      )

      # Ban de thep
      add_box(
        entities,
        x - 0.22,
        -0.22,
        0.0,
        0.44,
        0.44,
        0.08,
        @steel_mat
      )

      # Cot thep tron
      add_cylinder(
        entities,
        x,
        0.0,
        0.08,
        0.14,
        SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.08,
        @steel_mat,
        32
      )

      # Dai cot
      add_cylinder(
        entities,
        x,
        0.0,
        SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.12,
        0.17,
        0.12,
        @steel_dark_mat,
        32
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.14, 0.14].each do |dx|
        [-0.14, 0.14].each do |dy|
          add_cylinder(
            entities,
            x + dx,
            dy,
            0.08,
            0.012,
            0.12,
            @bolt_mat,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Dam ngang lien ket hai cot
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(-1.40, 0.0, SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.10),
      point(1.40, 0.0, SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.10),
      0.10,
      @steel_dark_mat
    )

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '09 - Maintenance Catwalk')
    entities = group.entities

    x1 = SIGN_CENTER_X - SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.18
    x2 = SIGN_CENTER_X + SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.18
    y1 = SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.10
    y2 = SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.70
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM_Z - 0.20

    add_box(
      entities,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      x2 - x1,
      y2 - y1,
      0.055,
      @steel_dark_mat
    )

    # Thanh gia cuong ben duoi san
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x1, y1, z),
      point(x2, y1, z),
      0.045,
      @steel_mat
    )

    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x1, y2, z),
      point(x2, y2, z),
      0.045,
      @steel_mat
    )

    0.upto(12) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 12.0
      add_beam(
        entities,
        point(x, y1, z + 0.03),
        point(x, y2, z + 0.03),
        0.015,
        @steel_mat
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO TUY CHON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    group = make_group(parent, '10 - Fixed Access Ladder')
    entities = group.entities

    x = SIGN_CENTER_X + SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.25
    y = SIGN_FRONT_Y + 0.25
    z0 = 0.10
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT

    # Hai thanh dung
    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x, y, z0),
      point(x, y, z1),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark_mat
    )

    add_beam(
      entities,
      point(x + 0.32, y, z0),
      point(x + 0.32, y, z1),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark_mat
    )

    # Bac thang
    count = ((z1 - z0) / 0.28).to_i

    0.upto(count) do |i|
      z = z0 + i * 0.28

      add_beam(
        entities,
        point(x, y, z),
        point(x + 0.32, y, z),
        0.022,
        @steel_mat
      )
    end

    group
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = point(3.0, -7.0, 4.0)
    target = point(0.0, 0.0, SIGN_BOTTOM_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2.0)
    up = vector(0, 0, 1)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, up)
    camera.perspective = true

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAIN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      'Create XBigSwitch 3D Wall Signage',
      true
    )

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'XBIGSWITCH NETWORKS - 3D WALL SIGN'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL

      build_backplate(root) if CREATE_BACKPLATE

      build_main_text(root)
      build_sub_text(root)
      build_x_logo(root)
      build_secondary_logo(root)

      build_mounting_brackets(root) if CREATE_MOUNTING_BRACKETS

      build_outdoor_foundation(root) if CREATE_OUTDOOR_FOUNDATION
      build_catwalk(root) if CREATE_CATWALK
      build_ladder(root) if CREATE_LADDER

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'XBIGSWITCH NETWORKS SIGNAGE CREATED'
      puts "Main text: #{MAIN_TEXT}"
      puts "Sub text: #{SUB_TEXT}"
      puts "Sign width: #{SIGN_WIDTH} m"
      puts "Sign height: #{SIGN_HEIGHT} m"
      puts 'Raised graphite letters and cyan/blue logo included.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation

      puts "SIGNAGE MODEL ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

description: Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu. - THANH PHAN: - 01. Tuong gach trang tri
ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Tuong gach trang tri
# 02. Ket cau gia do thep gan tuong
# 03. Than hop bien quang cao
# 04. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 05. Mat pano mau cam do
# 06. Vien nep kim loai sang mau
# 07. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Mockup"
# 08. Tam op hong va nep canh
# 09. Bu long va ban ma lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/signboard_mockup.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SignboardMockup
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WIDTH = 2.35
  HEIGHT = 0.88
  DEPTH = 0.22
  CENTER_Z = 3.25

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.035
  FACE_THICKNESS = 0.018
  BORDER_SIZE = 0.025

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING = true
  CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME = true
  CREATE_LETTERING = true
  CREATE_REAR_PLATE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = make_material('Wall - Grey Limestone', [151, 147, 136])
    @mortar = make_material('Wall - Mortar Joints', [90, 88, 82])
    @wall_shadow = make_material('Wall - Recessed Surface', [111, 108, 100])

    @cabinet = make_material('Sign - Dark Burgundy Cabinet', [53, 28, 35])
    @cabinet_side = make_material('Sign - Burgundy Side', [76, 34, 43])
    @frame = make_material('Sign - Dark Steel Frame', [43, 39, 40])

    @orange = make_material('Sign - Coral Orange Face', [246, 91, 54])
    @orange_dark = make_material('Sign - Inner Orange Border', [219, 65, 43])
    @white = make_material('Sign - Ivory White Trim', [245, 235, 213])
    @lettering = make_material('Sign - White Letters', [255, 249, 237])

    @steel = make_material('Mount - Galvanized Steel', [124, 125, 125])
    @steel_dark = make_material('Mount - Dark Steel', [55, 53, 54])
    @bolt = make_material('Mount - Metal Fasteners', [175, 171, 157])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON KIM LOAI VA BU LONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG GACH THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Architectural Brick Wall')
    e = g.entities

    wall_width = 4.0
    wall_height = 3.4
    wall_depth = 0.24
    wall_z = CENTER_Z - 1.7

    add_box(
      e,
      -wall_width / 2.0,
      0.12,
      wall_z,
      wall_width,
      wall_depth,
      wall_height,
      @wall
    )

    # Tao cac mach ngang tren mat tuong.
    z = wall_z + 0.08
    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(-wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        pt(wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        0.009,
        @mortar
      )
      z += 0.22
    end

    # Mach doc chia vien gach, so le theo tung hang.
    row = 0
    z = wall_z + 0.08

    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      offset = row.even? ? 0.0 : 0.18
      x = -wall_width / 2.0 + offset

      while x < wall_width / 2.0
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.105, z),
          pt(x, 0.105, z + 0.22),
          0.008,
          @mortar
        )
        x += 0.36
      end

      z += 0.22
      row += 1
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO HOP BIEN QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cabinet(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Sign Cabinet')
    e = g.entities

    x = -WIDTH / 2.0
    z = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0

    # Than hop chinh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x,
      -DEPTH,
      z,
      WIDTH,
      DEPTH,
      HEIGHT,
      @cabinet
    )

    # Nep hong ben trai tao chieu sau giong anh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x - 0.025,
      -DEPTH - 0.008,
      z - 0.025,
      0.075,
      DEPTH + 0.016,
      HEIGHT + 0.05,
      @cabinet_side
    )

    # Mat pano cam do.
    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.055,
      -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS,
      z + 0.055,
      WIDTH - 0.11,
      FACE_THICKNESS,
      HEIGHT - 0.11,
      @orange
    )

    # Vien kim loai sang bao quanh pano.
    front_y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS - 0.006

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + HEIGHT - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + WIDTH - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    # Nep do noi phia trong.
    inner = 0.075
    inner_border = 0.009

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + inner,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + HEIGHT - inner - inner_border,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG THEP BEN TRONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_internal_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Internal Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.055
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.055
    y = -DEPTH + 0.035
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.055
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.055

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)

    [-0.75, -0.25, 0.25, 0.75].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1),
        pt(x, y, z2),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    [0.20, 0.40, 0.60].each do |offset|
      z = z1 + offset
      next if z >= z2

      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z),
        pt(x2, y, z),
        0.015,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIA DO GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Wall Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    x_positions = [
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.10,
      WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.10
    ]

    z_positions = [
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.13,
      CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.13
    ]

    x_positions.each do |x|
      z_positions.each do |z|
        # Ban ma gan vao tuong.
        add_box(
          e,
          x - 0.06,
          0.035,
          z - 0.055,
          0.12,
          0.13,
          0.11,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Tay do vuong goc.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.12, z),
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          0.035,
          @steel
        )

        # Thanh noi vao mat sau bien.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          pt(x, -DEPTH + 0.02, z),
          0.035,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Bu long gan ban ma.
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          0.025,
          z,
          0.012,
          0.012,
          @bolt,
          16
        )
      end

  def add_3d_text(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z,

ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Tuong gach trang tri
# 02. Ket cau gia do thep gan tuong
# 03. Than hop bien quang cao
# 04. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 05. Mat pano mau cam do
# 06. Vien nep kim loai sang mau
# 07. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Mockup"
# 08. Tam op hong va nep canh
# 09. Bu long va ban ma lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/signboard_mockup.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SignboardMockup
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WIDTH = 2.35
  HEIGHT = 0.88
  DEPTH = 0.22
  CENTER_Z = 3.25

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.035
  FACE_THICKNESS = 0.018
  BORDER_SIZE = 0.025

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING = true
  CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME = true
  CREATE_LETTERING = true
  CREATE_REAR_PLATE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = make_material('Wall - Grey Limestone', [151, 147, 136])
    @mortar = make_material('Wall - Mortar Joints', [90, 88, 82])
    @wall_shadow = make_material('Wall - Recessed Surface', [111, 108, 100])

    @cabinet = make_material('Sign - Dark Burgundy Cabinet', [53, 28, 35])
    @cabinet_side = make_material('Sign - Burgundy Side', [76, 34, 43])
    @frame = make_material('Sign - Dark Steel Frame', [43, 39, 40])

    @orange = make_material('Sign - Coral Orange Face', [246, 91, 54])
    @orange_dark = make_material('Sign - Inner Orange Border', [219, 65, 43])
    @white = make_material('Sign - Ivory White Trim', [245, 235, 213])
    @lettering = make_material('Sign - White Letters', [255, 249, 237])

    @steel = make_material('Mount - Galvanized Steel', [124, 125, 125])
    @steel_dark = make_material('Mount - Dark Steel', [55, 53, 54])
    @bolt = make_material('Mount - Metal Fasteners', [175, 171, 157])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON KIM LOAI VA BU LONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG GACH THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Architectural Brick Wall')
    e = g.entities

    wall_width = 4.0
    wall_height = 3.4
    wall_depth = 0.24
    wall_z = CENTER_Z - 1.7

    add_box(
      e,
      -wall_width / 2.0,
      0.12,
      wall_z,
      wall_width,
      wall_depth,
      wall_height,
      @wall
    )

    # Tao cac mach ngang tren mat tuong.
    z = wall_z + 0.08
    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(-wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        pt(wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        0.009,
        @mortar
      )
      z += 0.22
    end

    # Mach doc chia vien gach, so le theo tung hang.
    row = 0
    z = wall_z + 0.08

    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      offset = row.even? ? 0.0 : 0.18
      x = -wall_width / 2.0 + offset

      while x < wall_width / 2.0
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.105, z),
          pt(x, 0.105, z + 0.22),
          0.008,
          @mortar
        )
        x += 0.36

      z += 0.22
      row += 1
    end

    g

      WIDTH - 0.11,
      FACE_THICKNESS,

    # Vien kim loai sang bao quanh pano.

      HEIGHT - 0.07,

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + inner,

      inner_border,

      @orange_dark
    )

    g

  # THONG SO CHINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  POST_RADIUS  = 0.32
  POST_HEIGHT  = SIGN_BOTTOM

  FOUNDATION_W = 1.8
  FOUNDATION_D = 1.8
  FOUNDATION_H = 1.4

  FRAME_DEPTH = 0.75
  FRAME_BAR   = 0.07
  TRUSS_BAR   = 0.045
  TRUSS_STEP  = 0.48

  CATWALK_DEPTH = 0.90
  CATWALK_THICKNESS = 0.07

  LADDER_WIDTH = 0.48
  LADDER_STEP  = 0.30

  CREATE_FOUNDATIONS = true
  CREATE_CATWALK = true
  CREATE_LADDER = true
  CREATE_LIGHTS = true
  CREATE_RAISED_TEXT = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA HINH HOC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def mm(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def p3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(mm(x), mm(y), mm(z))
  end

  def v3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def mat(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m.alpha = alpha
    m
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = mat('BB - Concrete', [145, 143, 136])
    @steel = mat('BB - Galvanized Steel', [118, 128, 137])
    @steel_dark = mat('BB - Dark Steel', [42, 49, 57])
    @steel_light = mat('BB - Silver Steel', [190, 198, 202])
    @red = mat('BB - Advertising Red', [188, 14, 35])
    @red_side = mat('BB - Panel Edge Red', [93, 8, 19])
    @white = mat('BB - Letter White', [248, 246, 235])
    @gold = mat('BB - Letter Gold', [237, 184, 67])
    @black = mat('BB - Letter Shadow', [24, 24, 24])
    @lamp = mat('BB - Lamp Housing', [65, 72, 78])
    @lamp_glow = mat('BB - Lamp Lens', [255, 242, 195])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, material)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    corners = [
      p3(x, y, z),
      p3(x + width, y, z),
      p3(x + width, y + depth, z),
      p3(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(mm(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, size, material)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    reference = v3(0, 0, 1)
    reference = v3(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    u = direction.cross(reference)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = mm(size) / 2.0

    corners = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, material, segments = 24)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      p3(x, y, z),
      v3(0, 0, 1),
      mm(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = material
    face.back_material = material
    face.pushpull(mm(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG BE TONG VA COT
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Foundations and Posts')
    e = g.entities

    [-POST_SPACING / 2.0, POST_SPACING / 2.0].each do |x|
      box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_W / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_D / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_H,
        FOUNDATION_W,
        FOUNDATION_D,
        FOUNDATION_H,
        @concrete
      )

      box(
        e,
        x - 0.42,
        -0.42,
        0.0,
        0.84,
        0.84,
        0.12,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long neo tren ban de
      [-0.29, 0.29].each do |dx|
        [-0.29, 0.29].each do |dy|
          cylinder(e, x + dx, dy, 0.12, 0.025, 0.08, @steel_light, 12)
        end
      end

      # Than cot thep tron
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.0,
        0.12,
        POST_RADIUS,
        POST_HEIGHT - 0.12,
        @steel,
        36
      )

      # Dai cot tren dinh
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0.0,
        SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.45,
        POST_RADIUS + 0.035,
        0.45,
        @steel_dark,
        36
      )

      # Ban ma lien ket tren cot
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.38,
        -0.45,
        SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.18,
        0.76,
        0.90,
        0.18,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG VIEN PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Billboard Perimeter Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM
    z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT
    y_front = -0.22
    y_back = y_front + FRAME_DEPTH

    # Thanh vien truoc va sau
    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z1), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z2), p3(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x1, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
      beam(e, p3(x2, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @steel_dark)
    end

    # Thanh noi chieu sau
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      [z1, z2].each do |z|
        beam(
          e,
          p3(x, y_front, z),
          p3(x, y_back, z),
          FRAME_BAR,
          @steel
        )
      end
    end

    # Thanh dung chia o khung sau
    1.upto(7) do |i|
      x = x1 + SIGN_WIDTH * i / 8.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y_back, z1),
        p3(x, y_back, z2),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIAN KHONG GIAN TAM GIAC PHIA DUOI PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lower_truss(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Lower Spatial Steel Truss')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.10
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.10
    z_top = SIGN_BOTTOM
    z_bottom = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.70
    y_front = -0.35
    y_back = 0.55

    # Hai day ngang chinh
    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z_top), p3(x2, y, z_top), 0.07, @steel_dark)
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z_bottom), p3(x2, y, z_bottom), 0.07, @steel_dark)

      count = (SIGN_WIDTH / TRUSS_STEP).ceil
      1.upto(count - 1) do |i|
        x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / count.to_f
        beam(
          e,
          p3(x, y, z_top),
          p3(x, y, z_bottom),
          TRUSS_BAR,
          @steel
        )
      end

      # Thanh giang cheo tam giac
      count = (SIGN_WIDTH / TRUSS_STEP).ceil

      0.upto(count - 1) do |i|
        xa = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / count.to_f
        xb = x1 + (x2 - x1) * (i + 1) / count.to_f

        if i.even?
          beam(
            e,
            p3(xa, y, z_bottom),
            p3(xb, y, z_top),
            TRUSS_BAR,
            @steel
          )
        else
          beam(
            e,
            p3(xa, y, z_top),
            p3(xb, y, z_bottom),
            TRUSS_BAR,
            @steel
          )
        end
      end
    end

    # Thanh giang ngang theo chieu sau
    count = (SIGN_WIDTH / TRUSS_STEP).ceil
    0.upto(count) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / count.to_f

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y_front, z_top),
        p3(x, y_back, z_top),
        TRUSS_BAR,
        @steel
      )

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y_front, z_bottom),
        p3(x, y_back, z_bottom),
        TRUSS_BAR,
        @steel
      )

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y_front, z_bottom),
        p3(x, y_back, z_top),
        TRUSS_BAR,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIANG CHEO HAI BEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_side_trusses(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Side Triangular Trusses')
    e = g.entities

    [-1, 1].each do |side|
      x = side * (SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.04)
      y1 = -0.22
      y2 = 0.55
      z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM
      z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT

      beam(e, p3(x, y1, z1), p3(x, y2, z1), TRUSS_BAR, @steel)
      beam(e, p3(x, y1, z2), p3(x, y2, z2), TRUSS_BAR, @steel)
      beam(e, p3(x, y1, z1), p3(x, y1, z2), TRUSS_BAR, @steel_dark)
      beam(e, p3(x, y2, z1), p3(x, y2, z2), TRUSS_BAR, @steel_dark)

      count = 7
      0.upto(count - 1) do |i|
        za = z1 + (z2 - z1) * i / count.to_f
        zb = z1 + (z2 - z1) * (i + 1) / count.to_f

        if i.even?
          beam(e, p3(x, y1, za), p3(x, y2, zb), TRUSS_BAR, @steel)
        else
          beam(e, p3(x, y2, za), p3(x, y1, zb), TRUSS_BAR, @steel)
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK VA LAN CAN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - Maintenance Catwalk')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -CATWALK_WIDTH / 2.0
    y1 = 0.55
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.82

    box(
      e,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      CATWALK_WIDTH,
      CATWALK_DEPTH,
      CATWALK_THICKNESS,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Thanh xương duoi san
    [-0.30, 0.0, 0.30].each do |dy|
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x1, y1 + dy, z - 0.05),
        p3(-x1, y1 + dy, z - 0.05),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh san catwalk ngang
    0.upto(18) do |i|
      x = x1 + CATWALK_WIDTH * i / 18.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z - 0.04),
        p3(x, y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH, z - 0.04),
        0.018,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can phia ngoai
    rail_y = y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH
    rail_z = z + 1.0

    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, rail_y, rail_z),
      p3(-x1, rail_y, rail_z),
      0.035,
      @steel
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, rail_y, z + 0.52),
      p3(-x1, rail_y, z + 0.52),
      0.025,
      @steel
    )

    0.upto(12) do |i|
      x = x1 + CATWALK_WIDTH * i / 12.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, rail_y, z + 0.04),
        p3(x, rail_y, rail_z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO CO LONG BAO VE
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladder(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Fixed Safety Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.65
    y = 0.75
    z0 = 0.15
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT + 0.30

    # Thanh doc
    beam(e, p3(x, y, z0), p3(x, y, z1), 0.035, @steel_dark)
    beam(
      e,
      p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH, y, z0),
      p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH, y, z1),
      0.035,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Bac thang
    count = ((z1 - z0) / LADDER_STEP).to_i

    0.upto(count) do |i|
      z = z0 + i * LADDER_STEP

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y, z),
        p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH, y, z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Long bao ve dang vong cung don gian
    [z0 + 1.8, z0 + 2.5, z0 + 3.2, z0 + 3.9].each do |z|
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x - 0.12, y + 0.20, z),
        p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH + 0.12, y + 0.20, z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x - 0.12, y + 0.20, z),
        p3(x - 0.12, y - 0.20, z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH + 0.12, y + 0.20, z),
        p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH + 0.12, y - 0.20, z),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAT PANO QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_billboard_face(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '07 - Red Advertising Face')
    e = g.entities

    x = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.045
    y = -0.245
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.045

    box(
      e,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      SIGN_WIDTH - 0.09,
      0.035,
      SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.09,
      @red
    )

    # Vien canh pano
    beam(
      e,
      p3(-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.005, SIGN_BOTTOM),
      p3(SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.005, SIGN_BOTTOM),
      0.035,
      @red_side
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.005, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT),
      p3(SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.005, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT),
      0.035,
      @red_side
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D TREN PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def raised_text(parent, text, x, z, size, depth, material, name)
    g = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        true,
        false,
        mm(size),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        mm(depth)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = material
        entity.back_material = material if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Dung chu len mat dung
      rotate = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        ORIGIN,
        X_AXIS,
        90.degrees
      )

      g.transform!(rotate)

      bounds = g.bounds
      target = Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          mm(x) - bounds.min.x,
          mm(-0.29) - bounds.min.y,
          mm(z) - bounds.min.z
        )
      )

      g.transform!(target)

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Loi tao chu '#{text}': #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_advertising_text(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '08 - Raised Advertising Text')
    e = g.entities

    # Dong chu chinh
    raised_text(
      g,
      'I AM',
      -1.05,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.62,
      0.90,
      0.035,
      @white,
      'I AM - White Raised Text'
    )

    raised_text(
      g,
      'JAYALAKSHMI',
      -2.95,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.93,
      0.49,
      0.025,
      @white,
      'JAYALAKSHMI - White Raised Text'
    )

    raised_text(
      g,
      'THE BRIDAL DESTINATION',
      -2.90,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.42,
      0.19,
      0.015,
      @white,
      'Tagline - White Text'
    )

    raised_text(
      g,
      'M.G. ROAD, THRISSUR',
      1.05,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.44,
      0.15,
      0.012,
      @gold,
      'Location - Gold Text'
    )

    # Hinh trang tri dang duong cheo
    beam(
      e,
      p3(2.45, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.55),
      p3(2.75, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.65),
      0.035,
      @gold
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(2.62, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.62),
      p3(2.95, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.45),
      0.025,
      @white
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DEN CHIEU SANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '09 - Billboard Floodlights')
    e = g.entities

    count = 9
    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.25
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.25
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT + 0.05

    0.upto(count - 1) do |i|
      x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / (count - 1).to_f

      # Chan den
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.055,
        0.05,
        z,
        0.11,
        0.10,
        0.055,
        @lamp
      )

      # Can den huong ra truoc pano
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, 0.08, z + 0.04),
        p3(x, -0.30, z + 0.20),
        0.025,
        @lamp
      )

      # Than den
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.09,
        -0.36,
        z + 0.12,
        0.18,
        0.10,
        0.055,
        @lamp
      )

      # Mat den
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.075,
        -0.375,
        z + 0.10,
        0.15,
        0.018,
        0.025,
        @lamp_glow
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = p3(11.0, -23.0, 15.0)
    target = p3(0.0, 0.0, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2.0)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, v3(0, 0, 1))
    camera.perspective = true

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO TOAN BO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation('Create Outdoor Billboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD - DOUBLE STEEL POSTS'
      )

      build_foundations(root) if CREATE_FOUNDATIONS
      build_panel_frame(root)
      build_lower_truss(root)
      build_side_trusses(root)
      build_billboard_face(root)
      build_advertising_text(root) if CREATE_RAISED_TEXT
      build_catwalk(root) if CREATE_CATWALK
      build_ladder(root) if CREATE_LADDER
      build_lights(root) if CREATE_LIGHTS

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '============================================'
      puts 'OUTDOOR BILLBOARD CREATED SUCCESSFULLY'
      puts "Pano: #{SIGN_WIDTH} x #{SIGN_HEIGHT} m"
      puts "Bottom elevation: #{SIGN_BOTTOM} m"
      puts 'Components: foundations, steel posts, trusses,'
      puts 'catwalk, ladder, advertising panel and lights.'
      puts '============================================'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "BILLBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# ================================================================
