require 'sketchup.rb'

module BridgeBillboard
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_WIDTH  = 7.20
  SIGN_HEIGHT = 2.10
  SIGN_BOTTOM = 7.80
  SIGN_DEPTH  = 0.18

  POST_SPACING = 8.00
  POST_RADIUS  = 0.16
  POST_HEIGHT  = 8.40

  FOUNDATION_WIDTH  = 0.90
  FOUNDATION_DEPTH  = 0.90
  FOUNDATION_HEIGHT = 1.20

  FRAME_BAR = 0.065
  FRAME_DEPTH = 0.30

  CATWALK_DEPTH = 0.55
  CATWALK_THICKNESS = 0.045

  LADDER_WIDTH = 0.38
  LADDER_STEP = 0.28

  CREATE_FOUNDATIONS = true
  CREATE_CATWALK = true
  CREATE_LADDERS = true
  CREATE_BACK_FRAME = true
  CREATE_RAISED_TEXT = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA HINH HOC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def mm(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def p3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(mm(x), mm(y), mm(z))
  end

  def v3(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m.alpha = alpha
    m
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = material('BB Concrete', [155, 155, 150])
    @steel = material('BB Galvanized Steel', [160, 169, 175])
    @steel_dark = material('BB Steel Dark', [74, 83, 91])
    @steel_light = material('BB Steel Light', [210, 216, 220])
    @frame_white = material('BB White Aluminium Frame', [235, 239, 237])
    @panel = material('BB Advertising Panel', [0, 151, 210])
    @panel_edge = material('BB Panel Edge', [38, 54, 62])
    @cyan = material('BB Cyan Graphic', [0, 225, 255])
    @green = material('BB Landscape Green', [61, 145, 56])
    @white = material('BB White Text', [255, 255, 255])
    @dark = material('BB Dark Text', [20, 51, 68])
    @silver = material('BB Silver Hardware', [205, 210, 214])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      p3(x, y, z),
      p3(x + width, y, z),
      p3(x + width, y + depth, z),
      p3(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(mm(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = v3(0, 0, 1)
    ref = v3(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = mm(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 32)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      p3(x, y, z),
      v3(0, 0, 1),
      mm(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(mm(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG BE TONG, BAN DE, COT THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Concrete Foundations and Steel Posts')
    e = g.entities

    [-POST_SPACING / 2.0, POST_SPACING / 2.0].each do |x|
      box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_WIDTH / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_DEPTH / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        FOUNDATION_WIDTH,
        FOUNDATION_DEPTH,
        FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de cot
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.28,
        -0.28,
        0,
        0.56,
        0.56,
        0.10,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.19, 0.19].each do |dx|
        [-0.19, 0.19].each do |dy|
          cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            dy,
            0.10,
            0.018,
            0.075,
            @silver,
            12
          )
        end
      end

      # Cot thep tron dung
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0,
        0.10,
        POST_RADIUS,
        POST_HEIGHT - 0.10,
        @steel,
        36
      )

      # Vong dai gia cuong tai dau cot
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0,
        SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.20,
        POST_RADIUS + 0.035,
        0.30,
        @steel_dark,
        36
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG VIEN PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Aluminium Perimeter Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM
    z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT

    y_front = -0.23
    y_back = y_front + FRAME_DEPTH

    # Khung truoc va sau
    [y_front, y_back].each do |y|
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z1), FRAME_BAR, @frame_white)
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z2), p3(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @frame_white)
      beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x1, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @frame_white)
      beam(e, p3(x2, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z2), FRAME_BAR, @frame_white)
    end

    # Thanh noi chieu sau
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      [z1, z2].each do |z|
        beam(e, p3(x, y_front, z), p3(x, y_back, z), FRAME_BAR, @steel)
      end
    end

    # Thanh dung phia sau pano
    1.upto(8) do |i|
      x = x1 + SIGN_WIDTH * i / 9.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y_back, z1),
        p3(x, y_back, z2),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG GIANG CHEO PHIA SAU PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_back_truss(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Rear Steel Bracing')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.05
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.05
    y = 0.10
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.05
    z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.05

    beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z1), 0.05, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, p3(x1, y, z2), p3(x2, y, z2), 0.05, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, p3(x1, y, z1), p3(x1, y, z2), 0.05, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, p3(x2, y, z1), p3(x2, y, z2), 0.05, @steel_dark)

    count = 10

    0.upto(count - 1) do |i|
      xa = x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / count.to_f
      xb = x1 + (x2 - x1) * (i + 1) / count.to_f

      if i.even?
        beam(e, p3(xa, y, z1), p3(xb, y, z2), 0.035, @steel)
      else
        beam(e, p3(xa, y, z2), p3(xb, y, z1), 0.035, @steel)
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH NGANG NOI HAI COT
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cross_support(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Cross Supports')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -POST_SPACING / 2.0
    x2 = POST_SPACING / 2.0

    # Dam ngang chinh phia duoi pano
    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.20),
      p3(x2, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.20),
      0.18,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Thanh lien ket phia tren
    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.25),
      p3(x2, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.25),
      0.10,
      @steel
    )

    # Gia cuong tu cot len khung
    [-1, 1].each do |side|
      x = side * POST_SPACING / 2.0
      x_inner = side * (SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.20)

      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.20),
        p3(x_inner, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.20),
        0.08,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - Rear Maintenance Catwalk')
    e = g.entities

    width = SIGN_WIDTH + 0.40
    x1 = -width / 2.0
    y1 = 0.30
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.45

    # Tam san
    box(
      e,
      x1,
      y1,
      z,
      width,
      CATWALK_DEPTH,
      CATWALK_THICKNESS,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc san
    [y1 + 0.08, y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH - 0.08].each do |y|
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x1, y, z - 0.08),
        p3(-x1, y, z - 0.08),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang san
    0.upto(16) do |i|
      x = x1 + width * i / 16.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, y1, z - 0.06),
        p3(x, y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH, z - 0.06),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Lan can phia ngoai
    rail_y = y1 + CATWALK_DEPTH
    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, rail_y, z + 0.90),
      p3(-x1, rail_y, z + 0.90),
      0.035,
      @steel
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(x1, rail_y, z + 0.45),
      p3(-x1, rail_y, z + 0.45),
      0.025,
      @steel
    )

    0.upto(12) do |i|
      x = x1 + width * i / 12.0
      beam(
        e,
        p3(x, rail_y, z),
        p3(x, rail_y, z + 0.90),
        0.025,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO CO LONG BAO VE
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladders(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Fixed Access Ladders')
    e = g.entities

    [-POST_SPACING / 2.0 + 0.20, POST_SPACING / 2.0 - 0.20].each do |x|
      y = 0.22
      z0 = 0.15
      z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.30

      # Hai thanh doc
      beam(e, p3(x - LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z0),
           p3(x - LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z1), 0.028, @steel_dark)

      beam(e, p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z0),
           p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z1), 0.028, @steel_dark)

      count = ((z1 - z0) / LADDER_STEP).to_i

      0.upto(count) do |i|
        z = z0 + i * LADDER_STEP
        beam(
          e,
          p3(x - LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z),
          p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0, y, z),
          0.022,
          @steel_light
        )
      end

      # Gia lap dai bao ve tren doan tren cao
      6.upto(10) do |i|
        z = z0 + i * 0.55
        next if z > z1

        beam(
          e,
          p3(x - LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.10, y + 0.12, z),
          p3(x + LADDER_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.10, y + 0.12, z),
          0.020,
          @steel
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAT PANO QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel_face(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '07 - Advertising Pano')
    e = g.entities

    x = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.065
    y = -0.255
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.065

    box(
      e,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      SIGN_WIDTH - 0.13,
      0.035,
      SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.13,
      @panel
    )

    # Nep vien phu
    beam(
      e,
      p3(-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.01, SIGN_BOTTOM),
      p3(SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.01, SIGN_BOTTOM),
      0.025,
      @frame_white
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.01, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT),
      p3(SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0, y - 0.01, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT),
      0.025,
      @frame_white
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI TREN MAT PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def raised_text(parent, text, x, z, height, depth, mat, name)
    g = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignLeft,
        'Arial',
        true,
        false,
        mm(height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        mm(depth)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Xoay chu dung tren mat pano
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(
          ORIGIN,
          X_AXIS,
          90.degrees
        )
      )

      bounds = g.bounds

      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.translation(
          Geom::Vector3d.new(
            mm(x) - bounds.min.x,
            mm(-0.30) - bounds.min.y,
            mm(z) - bounds.min.z
          )
        )
      )
    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Khong tao duoc chu #{text}: #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_panel_text(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '08 - Raised Panel Text')
    e = g.entities

    raised_text(
      g,
      'ENERGY',
      -2.45,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.30,
      0.36,
      0.015,
      @dark,
      'Headline - ENERGY'
    )

    raised_text(
      g,
      'POWER FOR EVERYONE',
      -2.45,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.88,
      0.20,
      0.012,
      @dark,
      'Subheadline'
    )

    # Duong trang tri mau cyan
    beam(
      e,
      p3(-0.60, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.40),
      p3(0.25, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.70),
      0.055,
      @cyan
    )

    beam(
      e,
      p3(-0.35, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.40),
      p3(0.50, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.70),
      0.035,
      @cyan
    )

    # Cot thap dien minh hoa
    beam(
      e,
      p3(2.15, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.35),
      p3(2.45, -0.30, SIGN_BOTTOM + 1.45),
      0.025,
      @steel_dark
    )

    [-0.10, 0.08, 0.24].each do |offset|
      beam(
        e,
        p3(2.15 + offset, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.75),
        p3(2.15 - offset, -0.31, SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.75),
        0.018,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = p3(0, -18, 9.0)
    target = p3(0, 0, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2.0)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, v3(0, 0, 1))
    camera.perspective = true

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation('Create Bridge Billboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'OUTDOOR BRIDGE BILLBOARD'
      )

      build_foundations(root) if CREATE_FOUNDATIONS
      build_cross_support(root)
      build_panel_frame(root)
      build_back_truss(root) if CREATE_BACK_FRAME
      build_panel_face(root)
      build_panel_text(root) if CREATE_RAISED_TEXT
      build_catwalk(root) if CREATE_CATWALK
      build_ladders(root) if CREATE_LADDERS

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '============================================'
      puts 'BRIDGE BILLBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Pano: #{SIGN_WIDTH} x #{SIGN_HEIGHT} m"
      puts "Bottom elevation: #{SIGN_BOTTOM} m"
      puts 'Two round steel posts, foundations, frame,'
      puts 'rear bracing, catwalk, ladders and pano.'
      puts '============================================'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "BILLBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Tuong gach trang tri
# 02. Ket cau gia do thep gan tuong
# 03. Than hop bien quang cao
# 04. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 05. Mat pano mau cam do
# 06. Vien nep kim loai sang mau
# 07. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Mockup"
# 08. Tam op hong va nep canh
# 09. Bu long va ban ma lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/signboard_mockup.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SignboardMockup
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WIDTH = 2.35
  HEIGHT = 0.88
  DEPTH = 0.22
  CENTER_Z = 3.25

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.035
  FACE_THICKNESS = 0.018
  BORDER_SIZE = 0.025

  CREATE_WALL = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING = true
  CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME = true
  CREATE_LETTERING = true
  CREATE_REAR_PLATE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall = make_material('Wall - Grey Limestone', [151, 147, 136])
    @mortar = make_material('Wall - Mortar Joints', [90, 88, 82])
    @wall_shadow = make_material('Wall - Recessed Surface', [111, 108, 100])

    @cabinet = make_material('Sign - Dark Burgundy Cabinet', [53, 28, 35])
    @cabinet_side = make_material('Sign - Burgundy Side', [76, 34, 43])
    @frame = make_material('Sign - Dark Steel Frame', [43, 39, 40])

    @orange = make_material('Sign - Coral Orange Face', [246, 91, 54])
    @orange_dark = make_material('Sign - Inner Orange Border', [219, 65, 43])
    @white = make_material('Sign - Ivory White Trim', [245, 235, 213])
    @lettering = make_material('Sign - White Letters', [255, 249, 237])

    @steel = make_material('Mount - Galvanized Steel', [124, 125, 125])
    @steel_dark = make_material('Mount - Dark Steel', [55, 53, 54])
    @bolt = make_material('Mount - Metal Fasteners', [175, 171, 157])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON KIM LOAI VA BU LONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TUONG GACH THAM KHAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '00 - Architectural Brick Wall')
    e = g.entities

    wall_width = 4.0
    wall_height = 3.4
    wall_depth = 0.24
    wall_z = CENTER_Z - 1.7

    add_box(
      e,
      -wall_width / 2.0,
      0.12,
      wall_z,
      wall_width,
      wall_depth,
      wall_height,
      @wall
    )

    # Tao cac mach ngang tren mat tuong.
    z = wall_z + 0.08
    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(-wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        pt(wall_width / 2.0, 0.105, z),
        0.009,
        @mortar
      )
      z += 0.22
    end

    # Mach doc chia vien gach, so le theo tung hang.
    row = 0
    z = wall_z + 0.08

    while z < wall_z + wall_height
      offset = row.even? ? 0.0 : 0.18
      x = -wall_width / 2.0 + offset

      while x < wall_width / 2.0
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.105, z),
          pt(x, 0.105, z + 0.22),
          0.008,
          @mortar
        )
        x += 0.36
      end

      z += 0.22
      row += 1
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO HOP BIEN QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cabinet(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Sign Cabinet')
    e = g.entities

    x = -WIDTH / 2.0
    z = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0

    # Than hop chinh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x,
      -DEPTH,
      z,
      WIDTH,
      DEPTH,
      HEIGHT,
      @cabinet
    )

    # Nep hong ben trai tao chieu sau giong anh.
    add_box(
      e,
      x - 0.025,
      -DEPTH - 0.008,
      z - 0.025,
      0.075,
      DEPTH + 0.016,
      HEIGHT + 0.05,
      @cabinet_side
    )

    # Mat pano cam do.
    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.055,
      -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS,
      z + 0.055,
      WIDTH - 0.11,
      FACE_THICKNESS,
      HEIGHT - 0.11,
      @orange
    )

    # Vien kim loai sang bao quanh pano.
    front_y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS - 0.006

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + HEIGHT - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      WIDTH - 0.07,
      0.012,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + 0.035,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + WIDTH - 0.035 - BORDER_SIZE,
      front_y,
      z + 0.035,
      BORDER_SIZE,
      0.012,
      HEIGHT - 0.07,
      @white
    )

    # Nep do noi phia trong.
    inner = 0.075
    inner_border = 0.009

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + inner,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      x + inner,
      front_y - 0.001,
      z + HEIGHT - inner - inner_border,
      WIDTH - inner * 2,
      0.006,
      inner_border,
      @orange_dark
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG THEP BEN TRONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_internal_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Internal Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.055
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.055
    y = -DEPTH + 0.035
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.055
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.055

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @frame)

    [-0.75, -0.25, 0.25, 0.75].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1),
        pt(x, y, z2),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    [0.20, 0.40, 0.60].each do |offset|
      z = z1 + offset
      next if z >= z2

      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z),
        pt(x2, y, z),
        0.015,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIA DO GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Wall Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    x_positions = [
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.10,
      WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.10
    ]

    z_positions = [
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.13,
      CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.13
    ]

    x_positions.each do |x|
      z_positions.each do |z|
        # Ban ma gan vao tuong.
        add_box(
          e,
          x - 0.06,
          0.035,
          z - 0.055,
          0.12,
          0.13,
          0.11,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Tay do vuong goc.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.12, z),
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          0.035,
          @steel
        )

        # Thanh noi vao mat sau bien.
        add_beam(
          e,
          pt(x, -0.18, z),
          pt(x, -DEPTH + 0.02, z),
          0.035,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Bu long gan ban ma.
        add_cylinder(
          e,
          x,
          0.025,
          z,
          0.012,
          0.012,
          @bolt,
          16
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM OP SAU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_rear_plate(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Rear Service Panel')
    e = g.entities

    add_box(
      e,
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.06,
      DEPTH * 0.30,
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.06,
      WIDTH - 0.12,
      0.025,
      HEIGHT - 0.12,
      @cabinet_side
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_3d_text(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z,
                  text_height, thickness, mat,
                  font = 'Arial', bold = false)
    g = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        m(text_height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(thickness)
      )

      # Chu mac dinh nam tren XY, xoay dung de huong ra mat bien.
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(
          ORIGIN,
          X_AXIS,
          90.degrees
        )
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      bounds = g.bounds

      target_x = m(center_x)
      target_y = -m(DEPTH + FACE_THICKNESS + 0.018)
      target_z = m(center_z)

      translation = Geom::Vector3d.new(
        target_x - (bounds.min.x + bounds.max.x) / 2.0,
        target_y - bounds.min.y,
        target_z - (bounds.min.z + bounds.max.z) / 2.0
      )

      g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(translation))

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text creation failed [#{text}]: #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOI DUNG MAT PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lettering(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - Raised White Typography')

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      'SignBoard Mockup Text',
      'SignBoard Mockup',
      0.0,
      CENTER_Z + 0.015,
      0.155,
      0.009,
      @lettering,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH GIA CUONG VA NEP VIEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_edge_details(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '06 - Edge Reinforcement')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.025
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.025
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.025
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.025
    y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICKNESS - 0.009

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.008, @white)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.008, @white)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(2.6, -4.6, CENTER_Z + 1.0)
    target = pt(0, 0, CENTER_Z)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      eye,
      target,
      vec(0, 0, 1)
    )

    camera.perspective = true
    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO TOAN BO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create SignBoard Mockup', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'SignBoard Mockup - Complete Assembly'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL
      build_cabinet(root)
      build_internal_frame(root) if CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME
      build_mounting(root) if CREATE_MOUNTING
      build_rear_plate(root) if CREATE_REAR_PLATE
      build_edge_details(root)
      build_lettering(root) if CREATE_LETTERING

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'SIGNBOARD MOCKUP CREATED'
      puts "Width:  #{WIDTH} m"
      puts "Height: #{HEIGHT} m"
      puts "Depth:  #{DEPTH} m"
      puts 'Wall, cabinet, steel frame, wall brackets,'
      puts 'coral panel, white trim and 3D lettering created.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "SIGNBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SKYWOW LED SIGNBOARD - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien quang cao pano nen xanh, chu noi vang phat sang.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Mong be tong
# 02. Cot thep hop/tron va ban ma neo
# 03. Khung xuong thep phia sau
# 04. Pano hop chu nhat
# 05. Mat bien xanh la
# 06. Chu noi 3D "Skywow"
# 07. Vien chu mau den va lop vien vang
# 08. Hieu ung vien LED phat sang gia lap
# 09. Khung treo, thanh gia cuong va den chieu sang
# 10. San catwalk va thang bao tri tuy chon
#
# Don vi: met
# X = ngang, Y = chieu sau, Z = chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/skywow_signboard.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module SkywowSignboard
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_WIDTH  = 4.80
  SIGN_HEIGHT = 2.15
  SIGN_DEPTH  = 0.16
  SIGN_BOTTOM = 4.20

  POST_SPACING = 3.60
  POST_RADIUS  = 0.12
  POST_HEIGHT  = 4.40

  FOUNDATION_WIDTH  = 0.65
  FOUNDATION_DEPTH  = 0.65
  FOUNDATION_HEIGHT = 0.70

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.055
  FRAME_DEPTH = 0.12

  CREATE_FOUNDATIONS = true
  CREATE_SUPPORTS = true
  CREATE_REAR_FRAME = true
  CREATE_CATWALK = true
  CREATE_LADDERS = true
  CREATE_LIGHTS = true
  CREATE_RAISED_TEXT = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI / TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @concrete = make_material('SW Concrete', [145, 145, 140])
    @steel = make_material('SW Galvanized Steel', [160, 170, 174])
    @steel_dark = make_material('SW Dark Steel', [48, 56, 54])
    @steel_light = make_material('SW Steel Highlights', [205, 212, 209])
    @panel_green = make_material('SW Emerald Green Panel', [28, 105, 64])
    @panel_edge = make_material('SW Panel Edge', [20, 35, 28])
    @black = make_material('SW Glossy Black Letter', [17, 15, 10])
    @gold = make_material('SW Warm Gold', [255, 205, 66])
    @gold_light = make_material('SW LED Warm White', [255, 238, 142])
    @white = make_material('SW White', [255, 255, 255])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    corners = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP GIUA HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!
    reference = vec(0, 0, 1)
    reference = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(reference)

    u = direction.cross(reference)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    corners = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 32)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG BE TONG VA COT
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_foundations(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Concrete Foundations and Posts')
    e = g.entities

    [-POST_SPACING / 2.0, POST_SPACING / 2.0].each do |x|
      box(
        e,
        x - FOUNDATION_WIDTH / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_DEPTH / 2.0,
        -FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        FOUNDATION_WIDTH,
        FOUNDATION_DEPTH,
        FOUNDATION_HEIGHT,
        @concrete
      )

      # Ban de chan cot
      box(e, x - 0.23, -0.23, 0, 0.46, 0.46, 0.08, @steel_dark)

      # Bu long neo
      [-0.15, 0.15].each do |dx|
        [-0.15, 0.15].each do |dy|
          cylinder(e, x + dx, dy, 0.08, 0.015, 0.04, @steel_light, 12)
        end
      end

      # Cot thep tron dung
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0,
        0.08,
        POST_RADIUS,
        POST_HEIGHT,
        @steel,
        36
      )

      # Dai gia cuong dau cot
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        0,
        SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.20,
        POST_RADIUS + 0.035,
        0.18,
        @steel_dark,
        36
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Billboard Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM
    z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT
    yf = -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0
    yb = SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 + 0.06

    # Khung vien truoc
    beam(e, pt(x1, yf, z1), pt(x2, yf, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_light)
    beam(e, pt(x1, yf, z2), pt(x2, yf, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_light)
    beam(e, pt(x1, yf, z1), pt(x1, yf, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_light)
    beam(e, pt(x2, yf, z1), pt(x2, yf, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_light)

    # Khung vien sau
    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z1), pt(x2, yb, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z2), pt(x2, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z1), pt(x1, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x2, yb, z1), pt(x2, yb, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)

    # Thanh noi truoc-sau
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      [z1, z2].each do |z|
        beam(e, pt(x, yf, z), pt(x, yb, z), FRAME_SIZE, @steel)
      end
    end

    # Thanh dung sau pano
    1.upto(8) do |i|
      x = x1 + SIGN_WIDTH * i / 9.0
      beam(e, pt(x, yb, z1), pt(x, yb, z2), 0.035, @steel)
    end

    # Thanh ngang gia cuong
    [0.35, 0.75, 1.15, 1.55, 1.90].each do |offset|
      z = z1 + offset
      next if z >= z2

      beam(e, pt(x1, yb, z), pt(x2, yb, z), 0.035, @steel)
    end

    # Giang cheo chu X
    0.upto(5) do |i|
      xa = x1 + i * SIGN_WIDTH / 6.0
      xb = x1 + (i + 1) * SIGN_WIDTH / 6.0
      next if xb > x2

      if i.even?
        beam(e, pt(xa, yb, z1), pt(xb, yb, z2), 0.025, @steel_dark)
      else
        beam(e, pt(xa, yb, z2), pt(xb, yb, z1), 0.025, @steel_dark)
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MAT BIEN XANH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_panel(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Emerald Green Sign Face')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.04,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.045,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + 0.04,
      SIGN_WIDTH - 0.08,
      0.045,
      SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.08,
      @panel_green
    )

    # Nep den quanh pano
    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM
    z2 = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT
    y = -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.075

    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.025, @panel_edge)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @panel_edge)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.025, @panel_edge)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.025, @panel_edge)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # Chu duoc tao tren mat phang XY, sau do xoay dung len mat pano.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_text_3d(entities, text, height_m, thickness_m, material_obj)
    entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      TextAlignCenter,
      'Arial',
      true,
      false,
      m(height_m),
      0.0,
      0.0,
      true,
      m(thickness_m)
    )

    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

      entity.material = material_obj
      entity.back_material = material_obj if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
    end
  end

  def make_text_group(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z, height, depth, mat)
    g = group(parent, name)

    begin
      add_text_3d(g.entities, text, height, depth, mat)

      # Chuyen chu tu XY sang mat phang XZ, huong ra phia truoc.
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees)
      )

      bounds = g.bounds
      desired_x = m(center_x)
      desired_y = m(-SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.11)
      desired_z = m(center_z)

      offset = Geom::Vector3d.new(
        desired_x - (bounds.min.x + bounds.max.x) / 2.0,
        desired_y - bounds.min.y,
        desired_z - (bounds.min.z + bounds.max.z) / 2.0
      )

      g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(offset))
    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text creation error (#{text}): #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU SKYWOW VA VIEN LED
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_letters(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - Skywow Raised Letters and LED')
    e = g.entities

    # Chu chinh mau vang kim loai
    make_text_group(
      g,
      'Skywow Gold Lettering',
      'Skywow',
      0.0,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.53,
      0.72,
      0.045,
      @gold
    )

    # Lop vien LED gia lap, chu nho hon va nam truoc chu chinh
    make_text_group(
      g,
      'Skywow LED Halo',
      'Skywow',
      0.0,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.53,
      0.75,
      0.018,
      @gold_light
    )

    # Nen den phia sau chu tao do day
    make_text_group(
      g,
      'Skywow Dark Letter Backing',
      'Skywow',
      0.0,
      SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT * 0.53,
      0.69,
      0.060,
      @black
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # GIA DO LIEN KET VA TAY DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_supports(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - Wall Brackets and Support Arms')
    e = g.entities

    [-BRACKET_SPACING / 2.0, BRACKET_SPACING / 2.0].each do |x|
      # Tay do ngang vuong goc voi mat pano
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, 0.10, BRACKET_HEIGHT),
        pt(x, -BRACKET_LENGTH, BRACKET_HEIGHT),
        0.065,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Thanh giang cheo
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, 0.10, BRACKET_HEIGHT - 0.08),
        pt(x, -BRACKET_LENGTH, BRACKET_HEIGHT - 0.40),
        0.045,
        @steel
      )

      # Ban ma gan tuong
      box(
        e,
        x - 0.12,
        0.06,
        BRACKET_HEIGHT - 0.20,
        0.24,
        0.08,
        0.40,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Bu long tren ban ma
      [-0.07, 0.07].each do |dx|
        [-0.08, 0.08].each do |dz|
          cylinder(
            e,
            x + dx,
            0.04,
            BRACKET_HEIGHT + dz,
            0.012,
            0.025,
            @steel_light,
            12
          )
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # MONG VA TUONG THAM CHIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = group(parent, '00 - Reference Wall')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -WALL_WIDTH / 2.0,
      0.22,
      0,
      WALL_WIDTH,
      WALL_THICKNESS,
      WALL_HEIGHT,
      @concrete
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DEN CHIEU SANG TREN PANO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lights(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - Top Sign Lights')
    e = g.entities

    [-0.42, 0.0, 0.42].each do |offset|
      x = offset * SIGN_WIDTH
      z = SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT + 0.10

      # Can den
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, -0.05, z),
        pt(x, -0.30, z + 0.10),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )

      # Than den
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        -0.30,
        z + 0.07,
        0.035,
        0.035,
        @steel_light,
        16
      )

      # Bong den
      cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        -0.30,
        z + 0.02,
        0.025,
        0.025,
        @gold_light,
        16
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAN CATWALK BAO TRI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_catwalk(parent)
    g = group(parent, '07 - Maintenance Platform')
    e = g.entities

    width = SIGN_WIDTH + 0.20
    x1 = -width / 2.0
    y = 0.16
    z = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.18

    # San thao tac
    box(
      e,
      x1,
      y,
      z,
      width,
      0.45,
      0.045,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Dam doc
    [y + 0.05, y + 0.40].each do |yy|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, yy, z - 0.08),
        pt(-x1, yy, z - 0.08),
        0.035,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang gia cuong
    0.upto(12) do |i|
      x = x1 + width * i / 12.0
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z - 0.06),
        pt(x, y + 0.45, z - 0.06),
        0.022,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANG LEO BAO TRI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_ladders(parent)
    g = group(parent, '08 - Maintenance Ladder')
    e = g.entities

    x = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.22
    y = 0.27
    z0 = 0.25
    z1 = SIGN_BOTTOM - 0.25
    ladder_width = 0.32
    rung_spacing = 0.28

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x - ladder_width / 2.0, y, z0),
      pt(x - ladder_width / 2.0, y, z1),
      0.025,
      @steel_dark
    )

    beam(
      e,
      pt(x + ladder_width / 2.0, y, z0),
      pt(x + ladder_width / 2.0, y, z1),
      0.025,
      @steel_dark
    )

    count = ((z1 - z0) / rung_spacing).to_i

    0.upto(count) do |i|
      z = z0 + i * rung_spacing
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x - ladder_width / 2.0, y, z),
        pt(x + ladder_width / 2.0, y, z),
        0.020,
        @steel_light
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(5.0, -8.0, 5.2)
    target = pt(0, -0.05, SIGN_BOTTOM + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2.0)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, vec(0, 0, 1))
    camera.perspective = true

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO MO HINH CHINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create Skywow LED Billboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = group(model.active_entities, 'SKYWOW LED SIGNBOARD')

      build_wall(root)
      build_foundations(root) if CREATE_FOUNDATIONS
      build_supports(root) if CREATE_SUPPORTS
      build_frame(root)
      build_panel(root)
      build_letters(root) if CREATE_RAISED_TEXT
      build_lights(root) if CREATE_LIGHTS
      build_catwalk(root) if CREATE_CATWALK
      build_ladders(root) if CREATE_LADDERS

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'SKYWOW LED SIGNBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Panel: #{SIGN_WIDTH}m x #{SIGN_HEIGHT}m"
      puts "Bottom elevation: #{SIGN_BOTTOM}m"
      puts 'Components: wall, foundations, steel frame,'
      puts 'green panel, raised letters, lights and supports.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "SKYWOW SIGNBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# THEGARA SIGNBOARD - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Mo hinh bien hieu hop dung doc lap theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Than bien dang hop chu nhat
# 02. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 03. Mat pano den nham
# 04. Chu noi 3D THEGARA
# 05. Dong chu phu CURATED GARMENTS & COLLECTIBLES
# 06. Gio hoat dong
# 07. Tay cam kim loai cong phia tren
# 08. Chan de va nep vien
#
# Don vi: met
# X = ngang, Y = chieu sau, Z = chieu cao
#
# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/thegara_signboard.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module ThegaraSignboard
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  SIGN_WIDTH  = 1.20
  SIGN_HEIGHT = 0.78
  SIGN_DEPTH  = 0.22

  BASE_Z = 0.06
  PANEL_Z = 0.10

  FRAME_SIZE = 0.025
  HANDLE_RADIUS = 0.008

  CREATE_HANDLE = true
  CREATE_TEXT = true
  CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME = true
  CREATE_BASE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI VA TOA DO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def vec(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def make_group(parent, name)
    g = parent.add_group
    g.name = name
    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def make_material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @black = make_material(
      'TG Matte Black',
      [29, 29, 32]
    )

    @black_edge = make_material(
      'TG Black Edge',
      [12, 12, 14]
    )

    @charcoal = make_material(
      'TG Charcoal Textured Face',
      [43, 43, 47]
    )

    @steel = make_material(
      'TG Brushed Stainless Steel',
      [160, 164, 168]
    )

    @steel_dark = make_material(
      'TG Dark Steel',
      [65, 68, 72]
    )

    @white = make_material(
      'TG White Lettering',
      [250, 250, 248]
    )

    @glow = make_material(
      'TG LED White',
      [255, 255, 255]
    )

    @rubber = make_material(
      'TG Rubber Feet',
      [20, 20, 20]
    )
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH HOP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!

    ref = vec(0, 0, 1)
    ref = vec(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    v = direction.cross(u)
    v.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    points = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(v, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(v, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH TRON KIM LOAI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 24)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      vec(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THAN BIEN
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_sign_body(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '01 - Main Sign Cabinet')
    e = g.entities

    # Vo hop chinh
    add_box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0,
      BASE_Z,
      SIGN_WIDTH,
      SIGN_DEPTH,
      SIGN_HEIGHT,
      @black
    )

    # Mat truoc mau than
    add_box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.018,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.003,
      PANEL_Z,
      SIGN_WIDTH - 0.036,
      0.008,
      SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.025,
      @charcoal
    )

    # Nep vien tren
    add_box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.008,
      BASE_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.025,
      SIGN_WIDTH,
      0.018,
      0.025,
      @steel_dark
    )

    # Nep vien hai ben
    add_box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.008,
      BASE_Z,
      0.018,
      0.018,
      SIGN_HEIGHT,
      @black_edge
    )

    add_box(
      e,
      SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.018,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.008,
      BASE_Z,
      0.018,
      0.018,
      SIGN_HEIGHT,
      @black_edge
    )

    # Nep vien duoi
    add_box(
      e,
      -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0,
      -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.008,
      BASE_Z,
      SIGN_WIDTH,
      0.018,
      0.018,
      @black_edge
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG BEN TRONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_internal_frame(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '02 - Internal Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.04
    x2 = SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.04
    y = SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.035
    z1 = BASE_Z + 0.035
    z2 = BASE_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT - 0.035

    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    add_beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)
    add_beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME_SIZE, @steel_dark)

    # Thanh dung gia cuong
    [-0.36, 0.0, 0.36].each do |x|
      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1),
        pt(x, y, z2),
        0.012,
        @steel
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang gia cuong
    [0.20, 0.40, 0.60].each do |offset|
      z = BASE_Z + offset
      next if z >= z2

      add_beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z),
        pt(x2, y, z),
        0.012,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def create_text(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z,
                  height, depth, mat, font = 'Arial', bold = true)
    g = make_group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        m(height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(depth)
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      # Xoay chu dung tren mat truoc cua bien.
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(
          ORIGIN,
          X_AXIS,
          90.degrees
        )
      )

      bounds = g.bounds

      target_x = m(center_x)
      target_y = -m(SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 + 0.012)
      target_z = m(center_z)

      translation = Geom::Vector3d.new(
        target_x - (bounds.min.x + bounds.max.x) / 2.0,
        target_y - bounds.min.y,
        target_z - (bounds.min.z + bounds.max.z) / 2.0
      )

      g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(translation))

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text error [#{text}]: #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  def build_lettering(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '03 - Raised White Typography')

    # Lop nen den tao do day cho chu chinh
    create_text(
      g,
      'THEGARA Shadow',
      'THEGARA',
      0.0,
      BASE_Z + 0.49,
      0.205,
      0.012,
      @black_edge,
      'Arial',
      true
    )

    create_text(
      g,
      'THEGARA Main',
      'THEGARA',
      0.0,
      BASE_Z + 0.505,
      0.205,
      0.018,
      @white,
      'Arial',
      true
    )

    create_text(
      g,
      'Curated Garments and Collectibles',
      'CURATED GARMENTS & COLLECTIBLES',
      0.0,
      BASE_Z + 0.405,
      0.043,
      0.010,
      @white,
      'Arial',
      true
    )

    create_text(
      g,
      'Opening Days',
      'TUES - SUN',
      0.0,
      BASE_Z + 0.235,
      0.050,
      0.010,
      @white,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    create_text(
      g,
      'Opening Hours',
      '11AM - 9PM',
      0.0,
      BASE_Z + 0.165,
      0.050,
      0.010,
      @white,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAY CAM KIM LOAI CONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_handle(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '04 - Curved Carry Handle')
    e = g.entities

    # Hai chan cam
    x1 = -0.43
    x2 = 0.43
    y = 0.0
    z = BASE_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT + 0.01

    add_cylinder(e, x1, y, z - 0.015, 0.014, 0.045, @steel, 16)
    add_cylinder(e, x2, y, z - 0.015, 0.014, 0.045, @steel, 16)

    # Tay cam uon thanh nhieu doan nho
    points = []
    segments = 28

    0.upto(segments) do |i|
      t = Math::PI * i / segments.to_f
      x = -0.43 + 0.86 * i / segments.to_f
      zz = z + 0.12 * Math.sin(t)
      points << pt(x, y, zz)
    end

    points.each_cons(2) do |a, b|
      add_beam(e, a, b, 0.012, @steel)
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHAN DE CAO SU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_feet(parent)
    g = make_group(parent, '05 - Rubber Feet')
    e = g.entities

    [
      [-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.08, -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 + 0.04],
      [SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.08, -SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 + 0.04],
      [-SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.08, SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.04],
      [SIGN_WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.08, SIGN_DEPTH / 2.0 - 0.04]
    ].each do |x, y|
      add_cylinder(
        e,
        x,
        y,
        0.015,
        0.035,
        0.045,
        @rubber,
        20
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(1.7, -3.0, 1.35)
    target = pt(0, 0, BASE_Z + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2.0)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(eye, target, vec(0, 0, 1))
    camera.perspective = true

    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create THEGARA Signboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = make_group(
        model.active_entities,
        'THEGARA - Freestanding Display Sign'
      )

      build_sign_body(root)
      build_internal_frame(root) if CREATE_INTERNAL_FRAME
      build_lettering(root) if CREATE_TEXT
      build_handle(root) if CREATE_HANDLE
      build_feet(root) if CREATE_BASE

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '=============================================='
      puts 'THEGARA SIGNBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Size: #{SIGN_WIDTH} x #{SIGN_HEIGHT} x #{SIGN_DEPTH} m"
      puts 'Main face, internal frame, raised typography,'
      puts 'curved metal handle and rubber feet completed.'
      puts '=============================================='

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "THEGARA SIGNBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

ruby_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# STOREFRONT SIGNBOARD - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo hinh anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Mang tuong gia lap va gia do gan tuong
# 02. Khung hop thep ben trong
# 03. Vo bien va mat pano mau do hong
# 04. Vien nep trang phat sang
# 05. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Storefront Mockup"
# 06. Ba nhan trang tri PSD / DESIGNED / MOCKUP
# 07. Tam op hong phia sau
# 08. Bu long va pat lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao
#
# Cach chay:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/storefront_signboard.rb'
# ================================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module StorefrontSignboard
  extend self

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THONG SO CHINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  WIDTH       = 1.85
  HEIGHT      = 1.15
  DEPTH       = 0.16
  CENTER_Z    = 3.25

  FRAME       = 0.035
  FACE_THICK  = 0.018
  BORDER      = 0.025

  CREATE_TEXT       = true
  CREATE_WALL       = true
  CREATE_MOUNTING   = true
  CREATE_BACK_PLATE = true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # DON VI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def m(value)
    value.to_f * 39.37007874015748
  end

  def pt(x, y, z)
    Geom::Point3d.new(m(x), m(y), m(z))
  end

  def v(x, y, z)
    Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, z)
  end

  def group(parent, name)
    result = parent.add_group
    result.name = name
    result
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VAT LIEU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, rgb, alpha = 1.0)
    materials = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = materials[name] || materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def setup_materials
    @wall_mat = material('Storefront - Warm Brick', [155, 91, 68])
    @mortar_mat = material('Storefront - Mortar', [206, 181, 164])
    @black = material('Sign - Black Cabinet', [30, 29, 31])
    @black_edge = material('Sign - Rear Dark Steel', [18, 18, 20])
    @red = material('Sign - Coral Red Face', [250, 83, 91])
    @red_side = material('Sign - Coral Side', [222, 63, 73])
    @white = material('Sign - White Trim', [245, 238, 235])
    @text_white = material('Sign - White Lettering', [255, 255, 255])
    @steel = material('Mount - Galvanized Steel', [150, 153, 157])
    @steel_dark = material('Mount - Dark Steel', [65, 67, 71])
    @glow = material('Sign - LED Glow', [255, 175, 178])
    @tag_mat = material('Sign - White Labels', [255, 250, 248])
    @tag_text = material('Sign - Label Text', [185, 94, 99])
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHOI HOP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def box(entities, x, y, z, width, depth, height, mat)
    return nil if width <= 0 || depth <= 0 || height <= 0

    points = [
      pt(x, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y, z),
      pt(x + width, y + depth, z),
      pt(x, y + depth, z)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(points)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # THANH THEP NOI HAI DIEM
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def beam(entities, a, b, size, mat)
    direction = b - a
    length = direction.length
    return nil if length < 0.001

    direction.normalize!
    ref = v(0, 0, 1)
    ref = v(0, 1, 0) if direction.parallel?(ref)

    u = direction.cross(ref)
    u.normalize!
    w = direction.cross(u)
    w.normalize!

    half = m(size) / 2.0

    corners = [
      a.offset(u, half).offset(w, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(w, half),
      a.offset(u, -half).offset(w, -half),
      a.offset(u, half).offset(w, -half)
    ]

    face = entities.add_face(corners)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(length)
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRU TRON / BU LONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def cylinder(entities, x, y, z, radius, height, mat, segments = 20)
    edges = entities.add_circle(
      pt(x, y, z),
      v(0, 0, 1),
      m(radius),
      segments
    )

    face = entities.add_face(edges)
    return nil unless face && face.valid?

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
    face.pushpull(m(height))
    face
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM TUONG GIA LAP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(parent)
    g = group(parent, '00 - Wall Reference')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -1.65, 0.20, CENTER_Z - 1.65,
      3.30, 0.12, 3.30,
      @wall_mat
    )

    # Cac duong mach gach ngang
    z_start = CENTER_Z - 1.60
    0.upto(10) do |i|
      z = z_start + i * 0.30
      beam(
        e,
        pt(-1.65, 0.065, z),
        pt(1.65, 0.065, z),
        0.008,
        @mortar_mat
      )
    end

    # Mach gach doc so le
    0.upto(10) do |row|
      z = z_start + row * 0.30
      offset = row.even? ? 0.0 : 0.22

      x = -1.65 + offset
      while x < 1.65
        beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.065, z),
          pt(x, 0.065, z + 0.30),
          0.008,
          @mortar_mat
        )
        x += 0.44
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VO BIEN QUANG CAO
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_cabinet(parent)
    g = group(parent, '01 - Sign Cabinet')
    e = g.entities

    x = -WIDTH / 2.0
    z = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0

    # Vo hop den
    box(
      e,
      x, -DEPTH, z,
      WIDTH, DEPTH, HEIGHT,
      @black
    )

    # Mat truoc pano
    box(
      e,
      x + 0.045, -DEPTH - FACE_THICK, z + 0.045,
      WIDTH - 0.09, FACE_THICK, HEIGHT - 0.09,
      @red
    )

    # Vien trang quanh mat truoc
    front_y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICK - 0.002

    box(
      e,
      x, front_y, z,
      WIDTH, 0.012, BORDER,
      @white
    )

    box(
      e,
      x, front_y, z + HEIGHT - BORDER,
      WIDTH, 0.012, BORDER,
      @white
    )

    box(
      e,
      x, front_y, z,
      BORDER, 0.012, HEIGHT,
      @white
    )

    box(
      e,
      x + WIDTH - BORDER, front_y, z,
      BORDER, 0.012, HEIGHT,
      @white
    )

    # Vien do phia trong tao hieu ung hai lop
    inner = 0.045
    red_border = 0.012

    box(
      e,
      x + inner, front_y - 0.001, z + inner,
      WIDTH - inner * 2, 0.006, red_border,
      @red_side
    )

    box(
      e,
      x + inner, front_y - 0.001, z + HEIGHT - inner - red_border,
      WIDTH - inner * 2, 0.006, red_border,
      @red_side
    )

    box(
      e,
      x + inner, front_y - 0.001, z + inner,
      red_border, 0.006, HEIGHT - inner * 2,
      @red_side
    )

    box(
      e,
      x + WIDTH - inner - red_border, front_y - 0.001, z + inner,
      red_border, 0.006, HEIGHT - inner * 2,
      @red_side
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # KHUNG XUONG THEP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_frame(parent)
    g = group(parent, '02 - Internal Steel Frame')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.045
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.045
    y = -DEPTH + 0.035
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.045
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.045

    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), FRAME, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), FRAME, @steel_dark)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), FRAME, @steel_dark)

    # Thanh dung gia cuong
    [-0.55, 0.0, 0.55].each do |x|
      beam(
        e,
        pt(x, y, z1),
        pt(x, y, z2),
        0.018,
        @steel_dark
      )
    end

    # Thanh ngang
    [0.25, 0.50, 0.75].each do |offset|
      z = z1 + offset
      next if z >= z2

      beam(
        e,
        pt(x1, y, z),
        pt(x2, y, z),
        0.015,
        @steel
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # PAT GAN TUONG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_mounting(parent)
    g = group(parent, '03 - Wall Mounting Brackets')
    e = g.entities

    z_top = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.12
    z_bottom = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.12

    [-0.78, 0.78].each do |x|
      [z_bottom, z_top].each do |z|
        # Pat gan tuong
        box(
          e,
          x - 0.045, 0.04, z - 0.05,
          0.09, 0.13, 0.10,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Tay do vuong goc
        beam(
          e,
          pt(x, 0.12, z),
          pt(x, -0.20, z),
          0.035,
          @steel
        )

        # Thanh lien ket vao than bien
        beam(
          e,
          pt(x, -0.20, z),
          pt(x, -DEPTH + 0.02, z),
          0.035,
          @steel_dark
        )

        # Bu long
        cylinder(
          e,
          x, 0.035, z,
          0.012, 0.012,
          @steel,
          16
        )
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAM OP PHIA SAU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_back_plate(parent)
    g = group(parent, '04 - Rear Mounting Plate')
    e = g.entities

    box(
      e,
      -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.06,
      DEPTH * 0.30,
      CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.06,
      WIDTH - 0.12,
      0.025,
      HEIGHT - 0.12,
      @black_edge
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CHU NOI 3D
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_3d_text(parent, name, text, center_x, center_z,
                  text_height, thickness, mat, font = 'Arial',
                  bold = false)
    g = group(parent, name)

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        text,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        m(text_height),
        0.0,
        0.0,
        true,
        m(thickness)
      )

      # Chu tao tren mat phang XY, sau do xoay de huong ra phia truoc.
      g.transform!(
        Geom::Transformation.rotation(
          ORIGIN,
          X_AXIS,
          90.degrees
        )
      )

      g.entities.each do |entity|
        next unless entity.respond_to?(:material=)

        entity.material = mat
        entity.back_material = mat if entity.respond_to?(:back_material=)
      end

      bounds = g.bounds

      target_x = m(center_x)
      target_y = -m(DEPTH + FACE_THICK + 0.020)
      target_z = m(center_z)

      translation = Geom::Vector3d.new(
        target_x - (bounds.min.x + bounds.max.x) / 2.0,
        target_y - bounds.min.y,
        target_z - (bounds.min.z + bounds.max.z) / 2.0
      )

      g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(translation))

    rescue StandardError => error
      puts "Text creation failed: #{text} - #{error.message}"
    end

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # NHAN TRANG TRI
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def add_capsule_tag(parent, center_x, center_z, width, label)
    g = group(parent, "Tag - #{label}")
    e = g.entities

    tag_height = 0.075
    front_y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICK - 0.025

    box(
      e,
      center_x - width / 2.0,
      front_y,
      center_z - tag_height / 2.0,
      width,
      0.008,
      tag_height,
      @tag_mat
    )

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      "Tag Text - #{label}",
      label,
      center_x,
      center_z,
      0.026,
      0.003,
      @tag_text,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOI DUNG CHU
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_lettering(parent)
    g = group(parent, '05 - Raised White Sign Typography')

    text_center_z = CENTER_Z + 0.14

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      'Title - SignBoard',
      'SignBoard',
      0.0,
      text_center_z + 0.17,
      0.145,
      0.009,
      @text_white,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      'Title - Storefront',
      'Storefront',
      0.0,
      text_center_z + 0.025,
      0.145,
      0.009,
      @text_white,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    add_3d_text(
      g,
      'Title - Mockup',
      'Mockup',
      0.0,
      text_center_z - 0.12,
      0.145,
      0.009,
      @text_white,
      'Arial',
      false
    )

    tag_z = text_center_z - 0.29

    add_capsule_tag(g, -0.28, tag_z, 0.17, 'PSD')
    add_capsule_tag(g, 0.00, tag_z, 0.27, 'DESIGNED')
    add_capsule_tag(g, 0.30, tag_z, 0.23, 'MOCKUP')

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # VIEN LED PHAT SANG
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build_led_trim(parent)
    g = group(parent, '06 - LED Border Accent')
    e = g.entities

    x1 = -WIDTH / 2.0 + 0.022
    x2 = WIDTH / 2.0 - 0.022
    z1 = CENTER_Z - HEIGHT / 2.0 + 0.022
    z2 = CENTER_Z + HEIGHT / 2.0 - 0.022
    y = -DEPTH - FACE_THICK - 0.004

    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z1), 0.007, @glow)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z2), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.007, @glow)
    beam(e, pt(x1, y, z1), pt(x1, y, z2), 0.007, @glow)
    beam(e, pt(x2, y, z1), pt(x2, y, z2), 0.007, @glow)

    g
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # CAMERA
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def set_camera
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    view = model.active_view

    eye = pt(2.6, -4.4, CENTER_Z + 1.0)
    target = pt(0, 0, CENTER_Z)

    camera = Sketchup::Camera.new(
      eye,
      target,
      v(0, 0, 1)
    )

    camera.perspective = true
    view.camera = camera
    view.zoom_extents
    view.invalidate
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAO TOAN BO MO HINH
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Create Storefront Signboard', true)

    begin
      setup_materials

      root = group(
        model.active_entities,
        'Storefront Signboard - Complete Model'
      )

      build_wall(root) if CREATE_WALL
      build_cabinet(root)
      build_frame(root)
      build_mounting(root) if CREATE_MOUNTING
      build_back_plate(root) if CREATE_BACK_PLATE
      build_led_trim(root)
      build_lettering(root) if CREATE_TEXT

      model.commit_operation
      set_camera

      puts '============================================'
      puts 'STOREFRONT SIGNBOARD CREATED'
      puts "Width: #{WIDTH} m"
      puts "Height: #{HEIGHT} m"
      puts "Depth: #{DEPTH} m"
      puts 'Cabinet, coral face, steel frame, wall brackets,'
      puts 'white trim, 3D lettering and label tags created.'
      puts '============================================'

    rescue StandardError => error
      model.abort_operation
      puts "SIGNBOARD ERROR: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# ================================================================
# SIGNBOARD MOCKUP - SKETCHUP RUBY
# Bien hieu hop gan tuong theo anh tham chieu.
#
# THANH PHAN:
# 01. Tuong gach trang tri
# 02. Ket cau gia do thep gan tuong
# 03. Than hop bien quang cao
# 04. Khung xuong thep ben trong
# 05. Mat pano mau cam do
# 06. Vien nep kim loai sang mau
# 07. Chu noi 3D "SignBoard Mockup"
# 08. Tam op hong va nep canh
# 09. Bu long va ban ma lien ket
#
# Don vi: met
# Truc X: ngang bien
# Truc Y: chieu sau (am Y huong mat bien)
# Truc Z: chieu cao

# Chay trong SketchUp Ruby Console:
# load 'C:/duong_dan/signboard_mockup.rb'
